December 27th 41

3

Further to : Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 1 p.m. 27-12-41 at the request of Lieutenant
Sakai of the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters (Press
Bureau) the undersigned accompanied by D. L. Sameshima
and D.J. Soong Ping Tsung proceeded to the premises of
the Union Publishers & Printers Fedn of Ind. U.S.A. 469
Macao Road, and there witnessed the opening and examination
of contents of four safes.

During above examination Mr. C. Ollerdessen
Secretary & Treasurer was present and after the examination
was completed the company was allowed to remove from the
main safe the sum of approximately $56,000.00 for purpose
of paying off its some 280 employees, after which all the
said safes were sealed, the keys for same being handed
over to Lieutenant Sakai who retained them.

It is understood that once all employees have
been paid the wages due to them, these premises will be
temporarily sealed by the Gendarmerie.

（批：Pay 28/12）
（印：DATE 28 / 12）
John Caygill

续：协助日本宪兵队

1941年12月27日下午1时，应日本宪兵队总部（新闻局）酒井中尉的请求，下述签署人会同 D. L. Sameshima 和 D.J. Soong Ping Tsung 前往澳门路469号美国工业联合会联合出版印刷公司（Union Publishers & Printers Fedn of Ind. U.S.A.）所在地，并在那里见证四个保险箱的开启和内容检查。

在上述检查期间，秘书兼财务主管 C. Ollerdessen 先生在场。检查完成后，允许该公司从主保险箱中取出约56,000.00元，用于支付其约280名员工的工资。此后，所有所述保险箱均被封存，钥匙移交给酒井中尉，由其保管。

据悉，一旦所有员工领到应付工资，日本宪兵队将暂时查封该场所。

（批注：12月28日付款）
（印章：日期 12 / 28）

Headquarters

December 23rd
41
1

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie re the
Union Publishers & Printers Fed. Inc. 469
Macao Road.

At 10.15 a.m. December 22, 1941, Sub-Lieutenant
Ski and other members of Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarter
attended C.B.H.Q. (C.I.) and requested assistance to
visit a printing establishment on Macao Road and make a
search re anti-Japanese literature etc.

Assistance was rendered by D.S. Shimashima and
the undersigned when the Union Publishers & Printers
Fed. Inc. U.S.A. 469 Macao Road was visited and Mr. L.H.
Wong, sub-manager, residing Lane 375/2 Myburgh Road,
interviewed.

It was learned from the Gendarmerie that the
Union Publishers & Printers was, until 1938, the Chung
Hwa Book Co. Ltd when they sold the business to the
present owners. Mr. Wong confirmed this stating the Chung
Hwa Book Co. Ltd still rent godowns and office space in
the building.

At the request of the Gendarmerie Mr. Wong
showed combined parties over the premises. The Gendar-
merie sealed the godown space rented by the Chung Hwa
Book Co. Ltd but did not interfere with the functioning
of the Union Publishers & Printers.

1

关于协助日本宪兵队处理
澳门路469号联合出版印刷联合会有限公司（Union Publishers & Printers Fed. Inc.）事宜。

1941年12月22日上午10时15分，日本宪兵队总部的 Ski 少尉及其他成员来到刑侦处总部（C.I.），请求协助访问澳门路的一家印刷厂，并搜查反日文献等物品。

D.S. Shimashima 和下述签署人提供了协助，访问了美国注册的澳门路469号联合出版印刷联合会有限公司，并约谈了居住在缪尔赫德路（Myburgh Road）375弄2号的副经理 L.H. Wong 先生。

从宪兵队处获悉，联合出版印刷公司在1938年之前是中华书局有限公司，当时他们将业务出售给了现任所有者。Wong 先生证实了这一点， stating 中华书局有限公司仍租用该大楼的仓库和办公空间。

应宪兵队的要求，Wong 先生带领联合小组参观了该场所。宪兵队封存了中华书局有限公司租用的仓库空间，但未干涉联合出版印刷公司的运作。

page_data.en:
1/2

Mr. Wong was requested to furnish particulars
re Bank notes printed for the Chungking Government.
This was proved to have been done on two occasions only
for the Central Bank of China, namely :

Sept. 1939 ---- 1 cent        $500,000 (face value)
Sept. 1939 ---- 5 cent        $500,000 (face value)
Nov.  1939 ---- 1 cent      $1,000,000 (face value)
Nov.  1939 ---- 5 cent      $5,000,000 (face value)

Contracts confirming these were produced.
Copies of them are being made for the Gendarmerie.

All plates, other than what is termed the
"Mother plate", have been destroyed as is customary.

The Gendarmerie also expressed their wish to
interview Mr. A F. Ollerdesson, president and general
manager of the Union Publishers & Printers at some
future time. This, it is understood, will be arranged,
{ Mr. Wong.
}
Pootoo Road Station informed of the visit.

〔此处为手写签名〕
D. S. I.
page_data.zh:
1/2

Wong 先生被要求提供有关为重庆政府印制钞票的详细情况。
经查证，仅为中国银行进行过两次此类印制，具体如下：

1939年9月 ---- 1分        $500,000 (面值)
1939年9月 ---- 5分        $500,000 (面值)
1939年11月 ---- 1分      $1,000,000 (面值)
1939年11月 ---- 5分      $5,000,000 (面值)

出示了确认这些交易的合同。
正在为宪兵队制作合同副本。

除所谓的“母版”外，所有印版均按惯例销毁。

宪兵队还表示希望在未来某个时间约谈联合出版印刷公司总裁兼总经理 A F. Ollerdesson 先生。据悉，这将由 { Wong 先生 } 安排。
已通知普陀路捕房此次访问事宜。

〔此处为手写签名〕
D. S. I.

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 5.45 p.m. 26-12-4. arrest at pier lands of
the Aoraki , Japanese Gendarmerie requested
assistance to visit address 34 Powell Road
to arrest a person:- Wang Young (王荣宝) 32, Tsingpo
who had been implicated by a prisoner already in the
custody of the Gendarmerie in anti-Japanese activities.

Assistance was rendered by D.I. Pryde, D.S.
Yoshikawa and Det. Lieu Shao T'eh and the stated
address visited where the foreign managers named Mrs.
Sweet was interviewed.

No person bearing the name of the wanted man
is known at this address, either as a tenant or an
employee. Mrs. Sweet was shown the photograph of the
wanted man and stated that the face appeared familiar
to her but she could not place exactly who it was. The
liftman and watchman were also shown the photograph
without any further result. It is possible that the
wanted man is a chauffeur of a tenant or ex-tenant
and enquiries are being made accordingly at the
Traffic Office.

（批：S/L 8L 2H.12-5.）
（批：Desp/v.）
（印：INDEXED BY (G.S.) REGISTRY DATE / 1 H）
（批：PJJ 24/12）

D. I.

协助日本宪兵队

1941年12月26日下午5时45分，在“Aoraki”号（音译）码头登陆处，日本宪兵队请求协助访问鲍威尔路（Powell Road）34号，以逮捕一人：王荣宝（Wang Young），32岁，宁波人，因涉及反日活动而被宪兵队已拘留的一名囚犯供出。

D.I. Pryde、D.S. Yoshikawa 和侦探刘绍德（Lieu Shao T'eh，音译）提供了协助，并访问了上述地址，约谈了名为 Sweet 夫人的外籍经理。

在该地址，无论是作为租户还是雇员，均无人知晓有此姓名者。向 Sweet 夫人展示了通缉犯的照片，她表示面容眼熟，但无法确切指出是谁。电梯操作员和看守也看了照片，但无进一步结果。通缉犯可能是某租户或前租户的司机，因此正据此向交通股进行查询。

（批注：S/L 8L 2H.12-5.）

December 21, 41.

1.

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie Authorities.

At 3 a.m. on 26-12-41, Sergeant Major Sugimoto of the
Japanese Gendarmerie requested assistance in effecting
the arrest of Chinese at No. 31, Po Tung Road, Yu Ya
Ching Road, who are, according to their own stories,
transacting certain affairs in the above room.

Accompanied by Cpl. Lee Ju
Poh, D.C.I. Kovaloff and the undersigned and the given
address visited, where the undermentioned 4 persons were
arrested at the request of Sgt. Major Sugimoto, but nothing
of an incriminating nature was found in their possession:-

1. Koo Ling Tsun (顧炳章), 28, Nankoi, s/shop-assistant,
residing in Footung, C.I. Prisoner No. 393/41,
2. Peu Kwang Yao (潘光耀), 26, "anwei, m/native doctor,
residing in Footung, C.I. Prisoner No. 394/41,
3. Dong Sze Tiang (唐水祥), 21, "anwei, m/shop-assistant,
residing in Footung, C.I. Prisoner No. 395/41,
4. Peu Kwei Shing (潘南興), 30, "anwei, m/Shop-assistant,
residing in Footung, C.I. Prisoner No. 396/41.

They were carefully questioned at C.I. Office, when the
1st named stated that he was aware that 13 hand grenades
have been buried in a vacant piece of ground at San Tung
( ), Nanwoi, Pootung by his uncle named Koo Wei Nyoh
( ) and sister-in-law named Peu Myi Sz ( ),
and he came to Shanghai with his companion with intent to
report the matter to the Japanese Gendarmerie Authorities.

Sgt. Major Sugimoto requested the loan of the above

1941年12月21日。

1.

协助日本宪兵队当局。

1941年12月26日凌晨3时，日本宪兵队的 Sugimoto 警曹长请求协助逮捕位于浦东路31号、虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Road）的中国人，据他们自己陈述，他们在上述房间办理某些事务。

在下述签署人陪同下，会同警员李祖波（Lee Ju Poh）、副探长 Kovaloff 访问了给定地址，应 Sugimoto 警曹长的要求逮捕了以下4人，但在他们身上未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品：-

1. 顾炳章（Koo Ling Tsun），28岁，南汇人，男/店员，居住于浦东，刑事调查处囚犯编号 393/41，
2. 潘光耀（Peu Kwang Yao），26岁，“anwei（原文不清，疑为安徽或地名）人，男/中医，居住于浦东，刑事调查处囚犯编号 394/41，
3. 唐水祥（Dong Sze Tiang），21岁，“anwei（原文不清）人，男/店员，居住于浦东，刑事调查处囚犯编号 395/41，
4. 潘南兴（Peu Kwei Shing），30岁，“anwei（原文不清）人，男/店员，居住于浦东，刑事调查处囚犯编号 396/41。

他们在刑事调查处办公室接受了仔细讯问，其中第一人陈述，他知道他的叔叔顾维诺（Koo Wei Nyoh，音译）和嫂嫂潘梅氏（Peu Myi Sz，音译）在浦东南汇三团（San Tung，括号内原文缺失）的一块空地上埋藏了13枚手榴弹，他和同伴来上海是为了向日本宪兵队当局报告此事。

Sugimoto 警曹长请求借用上述

1

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 3.30 p.m. 27-12-41, Sergeant Fujita of the
Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters, accompanied by
complainant Mr. Ching (吳博), a/manager of the Chung
Foo Silk Factory, House 13, Lane 1004 Yuhang Road,
came to Crime Branch Headquarters and requested
assistance to visit the Kwan Son Yuen Restaurant,
Nanking Road, for purpose of effecting the arrest of
five or six male orientals who had falsely represented
themselves to be members of the Japanese Gendarmerie
and were attempting to extort the sum of $50,000.00
from Mr. Foo Ching.

Sergeant Fujita gave additional information to the
effect that these men might be armed as on the 24th
December 1941 when keeping a rendezvous with the
complainant one of them had produced a pistol, at the
same time explaining that he was a member of the Japanese
Gendarmerie.

Complainant Mr. Woo Ching when questioned stated
that on the morning of 24th December 1941, he had
received a telephone message from some unknown person
asking him to call at room 224 Great Eastern Hotel in
re his factory having previously been registered with

1

协助日本宪兵队

1941年12月27日下午3时30分，日本宪兵队总部的藤田（Fujita）警佐，随同控告人吴博先生（Mr. Ching (吳博)），即余杭路1004弄13号中福丝厂经理，来到刑事科总部，请求协助前往南京路的冠生园酒家（Kwan Son Yuen Restaurant），以逮捕五至六名冒充日本宪兵队成员并企图向吴博先生勒索50,000.00美元的东方男性。

藤田警佐补充提供情报称，这些人可能持有武器，因为在1941年12月24日与控告人会面时，其中一人曾掏出手枪，同时声称自己是日本宪兵队成员。

经讯问，控告人吴清（Woo Ching）先生陈述，1941年12月24日上午，他接到某不明身份者的电话留言，要求他前往大华饭店（Great Eastern Hotel）224房间，事由是其工厂此前已向

page_data.en:
the American Authorities, the Japanese Gendarmerie
were not enquiring into such cases.
At 8.30 p.m. 24-12-41 Mr. **〔此处转录不清〕** called at the
room in question and there met a male Chinese who gave
his name as Chen and explained that he was working for
one named Kao Pei (高沛), a member of the Japanese
Gendarmerie who had been detailed to investigate the
original ownership of the Chung Hsing Factory, as
it had been reported that same had previously been
registered under the American Authorities.
Shortly after this conversation five other male
orientals entered the room, some in foreign dress,
and one of them was introduced to him as Kao Pei. This
man immediately took a pistol from his pocket and placed
same on the table after which it is alleged he informed
the complainant that for 20% of the capital of his
company he could settle the matter. As this amounted
to approximately $80,000.00 complainant asked for
time to consider the matter and in the meantime made
contact with the Gendarmerie Headquarters through a
friend, resulting in him fixing a rendezvous this
afternoon (27-12-41) at the Kwan San Yuan Restaurant,
Nanking Road.

1941年12月24日晚上8时30分，**〔此处转录不清〕**先生前往上述房间，在那里遇到一名自称陈姓的中国男子，该男子解释说他为一名叫高沛（Kao Pei）的人工作，高沛是日本宪兵队成员，奉命调查中兴工厂（Chung Hsing Factory）的原始所有权，因为据报该厂此前已在美国当局注册。
谈话后不久，另外五名东方男性进入房间，其中一些人身着西式服装，其中一人被介绍为高沛。此人立即从口袋中取出一把手枪放在桌上，随后据称他告知控告人，只要给予其公司资本的20%，即可解决此事。由于这笔金额约为80,000.00美元，控告人要求时间考虑此事，同时通过朋友与宪兵队总部取得联系，结果约定于当天下午（1941年12月27日）在南京路的冠三元餐厅（Kwan San Yuan Restaurant）会面。

1.

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 2.05 p.m. 31/12/41, Sgt.-Major Maejima of
the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters Foreign Affairs
Section accompanied by a Japanese informer came to
C. 1. office C.B.H.Q. and requested immediate assistance
in effecting the arrest of a Greek subject who it was
alleged had been concerned in trafficking in firearms
at the Central Mansion in 941 Bubbling Well Road.

Acting on the instructions of O. i/c C. 1,
the necessary assistance was rendered by D.S. Yamahara,
D.S.I. Zia Vai Faung, C.D.S. 40, C.D.C. 252 and the
undersigned. On the arrival there a large quantity
of wooden boxes were found stored on the ground floor.

Mr. D.G. Chelmis, Greek subject, manager of the
Central Mansion was interviewed re the above cargoes.
He stated that the 38 boxes contained "Babbitt Metal"
which had been kept there since 31 October 1941 at the
request of Mr. W.N. Malinovsky, Russian, and Mr. P. Em-
coustes, German. He further stated that the cargoes
had been registered at the Japanese Consulate General
by the above owners on 23/12/41 in answer to the pro-
clamation issued by the Japanese Authorities.

A wooden box was examined at the presence of
Mr. Chelmis ascertained that it contained 18 tins of
"Babbitt Metal".

（左侧手写批注：S / 6b / H.I.Hx）
（左侧圆形印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / JAN 5 1942 / SPECIAL BRANCH）

协助日本宪兵队

1941年12月31日下午2时05分，日本宪兵队总部外事课的前岛（Maejima）警曹长偕同一名日本线人来到中央捕房刑事科总部办公室，请求立即协助逮捕一名希腊籍男子，据称该人涉嫌在静安寺路941号中央公寓（Central Mansion）进行枪支走私活动。

根据刑事科主管的指示，由巡查长山原（Yamahara）、副巡长查伟芳（Zia Vai Faung）、40号华探、252号华探及签署人提供了必要协助。抵达现场后，发现一楼存放着大量木箱。

就上述货物事宜，对中央公寓经理、希腊籍男子D.G. Chelmis先生进行了问话。他称，这38个箱子内装有“巴氏合金”（Babbitt Metal），应俄罗斯人W.N. Malinovsky先生和德国人P. Emcoustes先生的要求，自1941年10月31日起一直存放于此。他还称，为响应日本当局发布的公告，上述物主已于1941年12月23日在日本总领事馆对这些货物进行了登记。

在Chelmis先生在场情况下检查了一个木箱，确认其中装有18听“巴氏合金”。

（左侧手写批注：S / 6b / H.I.Hx）
（左侧圆形印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1942年1月5日 / 特务科）
（左下角方框印章及手写：已索引 / (CH) / 9 / X 42）

page_data.en:

Mr. N.N. Malinovsky and Mr. Exaccoustos were
called to the Central Mansion and interviewed at 3 p.m.
same date.

Mr. N.N. Malinovsky, residing at Room 64
Medhurst Apartment, Bubbling Well Road stated that 19
boxes of "Rabbit Metal" total weight 2910 lbs value
C$29,100 belonged to him and the other 19 boxes of
"Metal" were the property of Mr. P. Exaccoustos residing
Room 301 Majestic Apartment, Bubbling Well Road and
that this metal had been registered at the Japanese
Consulate General on 23/12/41. A copy of the regis-
tration certificate was shown to Sgt. Major Maejima.

Sergeant Major Maejima was satisfied with the
enquiries but asked the owners not to remove the cargo
from the premises until completion of their own
enquiries at the Japanese Consulate General re the
registration.

Bubbling Well Station informed.

Klugimoto
S.

N.N. Malinovsky先生和Exaccoustos先生被召至中央公寓，并于同日午后3时接受问话。

居住在静安寺路麦赫斯特公寓（Medhurst Apartment）64室的N.N. Malinovsky先生称，19箱“巴氏合金”（原文误作Rabbit Metal），总重2910磅，价值法币29,100元，归其所有；另外19箱“金属”则归居住在静安寺路马杰斯蒂克公寓（Majestic Apartment）301室的P. Exaccoustos先生所有；且这些金属已于1941年12月23日在日本总领事馆登记。登记证书副本已出示给前岛警曹长查看。

前岛警曹长对调查结果表示满意，但要求物主在日本总领事馆完成关于登记的调查之前，不得将货物移出该处。

已通知静安寺捕房。

Klugimoto

Nagumo and two other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie
called at H.Q.C.B. (C.l.) Offices and requested
assistance on behalf of the J.N.L. Party to visit the
undermentioned two places wherein to arrest the
following two men wanted for their anti-Japanese
activities :-

200 Shanse Road, Nanking Hotel,
To arrest one named Woo Chih Yuin (吳吉雲),
a guide boy employed by this hotel.

545 Hupeh Road, Central Hotel,
To arrest one named Tsu Yoong Kong (朱永康),
also a guide boy employed by this hotel.

The desired assistance was rendered by D.S.
Sameshima, C.D.C.'s 184, 252 and the undersigned
and at 7.50 p.m. the Nanking Hotel was visited but the
wanted man could not be located. A visit to the
Central Hotel proved to be, likewise, unsuccessful.
C.D.C. 184 was, as requested by the gendarmes, posted
at this hotel to await the return of the wanted man.

Further to : Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

On the 23-1-42, Shankenko No. 83 dated 22-1-42, was received at C. I. Office, requesting immediate handing over of Kong Zee Sung (江岐生), age 30, residing at Room 16 of the Liang Shing Apartment, Rue Baron Gros, French Concession who was arrested by members of the S. M. P. and loaned to the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters on 14-1-42.

The arrested person had admitted to the Japanese Gendarmerie that he was engaged in guerilla activities in Kiangsu. He was a member of the New 4th Route Army. He, at the time of a Bandit Clearing Campaign, left for Shanghai with a sum of $15,000.00 which he admits to misappropriating.

The prisoner is still in the custody of the Japanese Gendarmerie.

At 9 a.m. 24-1-42 Sergeant Major Ikeda accompanied by other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie and a Korean Prisoner Lee Kai Chu (木山吉平) arrested in the French Concession on the 5-1-42 for falsely representing himself to a member of the Gendarmerie, came to Crime Branch H.Q. and requested assistance to visit three addresses in the International Settlement for purpose of locating complainants and witnesses in instances where the above accused had extorted money under the name of the Gendarmerie.

The Stations concerned having been informed the desired assistance was rendered by D.I. Crighton, D.S. Yamhara, and C.D.S. 341.

The first address to be visited was the Shanghai Sing Lee Zoo (上海新旅社) Lodging House, room 306, located at 579 Mikiang Road and occupied by one named Ting Zang Woo (丁仕華), however subsequent enquiries revealed that this man had left that address on the 29-12-41 for an unknown destination. Two tea-boys namely Tzu Chah Ching (周嘉金) and Tzu Wang Tao (周文耀) who were allegedly to have been in the room when the extortion took place, will attend Crime Branch H.Q. on the 25/1/42.

在通知相关捕房后，克里克顿（Crighton）督察长、山原（Yamhara）刑事侦探警士及刑事侦探警士341号提供了所需协助。

第一个要探访的地址是位于闵行路579号的上海新旅社（Shanghai Sing Lee Zoo）寄宿舍306室，由一名名为丁仕華（Ting Zang Woo）的人居住，但随后的调查显示，此人已于1941年12月29日离开该地址，去向不明。两名茶房，即周嘉金（Tzu Chah Ching）和周文耀（Tzu Wang Tao），据称勒索发生时曾在该房间内，他们将于1942年1月25日到刑事科总部。

My name is Sung Tsung Fong, age 37, native of Chinkiang,
M/Hardware broker, residing at House No.45 Fong Yue Li, Rue
Chapsai, French Concession.

At about 6 p.m. 6-1-42 I left my home and proceeded to
49 Kwangse Road for the purpose of locating one named Doo Ah
Tsi alias Tong Sung Sz, friend of my wife, who according to
my wife, could do something on the application of any kind
of permits, issued by the Japanese Authorities, as she had
several friends working in the Japanese Gendarmerie. The reason
why I went to visit Doo Ah Tsi being that my friend Tsang Yoch
Ding had several-ten bags of sugar which he intended to trans-
port to Nansiang for sale. As my friend had no permit for
the movement of sugar to Nansieng, he came to me and asked me
to help him.

On my arrival at 45 Kwangse Road I was arrested by
the police officers and brought to Crime Branch Headquarters
for enquiries.

This is my true statement.

Signed :
page_data.zh:
孙春芳
镇江                                // C.J.C. 211
C. B. U. A.                         翻译
                                    C.V. Chien

我叫孙春芳，37岁，镇江人，
男/五金经纪人，住法租界霞飞路丰裕里45号。

1942年1月6日下午6时许，我离开家前往广西路49号，目的是寻找一位名叫杜阿子（Doo Ah Tsi），别名唐松司（Tong Sung Sz）的人，他是我妻子的朋友。据我妻子说，他能帮忙办理日本当局签发的各类许可证，因为他在日本宪兵队有几个朋友。我去拜访杜阿子的原因是，我的朋友曾耀庭（Tsang Yoch Ding）有几十袋糖打算运往南翔出售。由于我的朋友没有将糖运往南翔的许可证，他来找我请求帮助。

当我到达广西路45号时，被警员逮捕并带至刑事科总部接受讯问。

以上是我的真实供词。

At 8.30 p.m. 3-1-42 Sergeant Asano of Gendarmerie
Headquarters came to C.B.H.Q. and requested assistance
to visit Room 504 of the Woo Kong Hotel, 152 Fokien Road
as he had received a report that a teller in the pay a
Korean and a number of Chinese who had represented them-
selves to be members of the Gendarmerie extorted $2000.00
from a Chinese named Tsang in this room. This Chinese
had been told to return at 8 p.m. with a further $3000.00
and had reported accordingly to the Gendarmerie.

Assistance was rendered by D.I. Pryde, D.S. Yamahara
and C.D.S. 206 and Room 504 of the Woo Kong Hotel was
found to be occupied by one named Sung Koh Tsing and
his family. These persons had been invited to the room
by one named Wong who was absent. After questioning the
occupants the Gendarmerie were satisfied that they were
not the persons concerned in the alleged extortion and
no arrests were made, the Gendarmerie returning to
Hongkew to further question their informant.

On the afternoon of 12-1-41 an identification
parade was held at Louza Station at which witnesses in

du Marche on 4-1-42 when $1,500 in cash was stolen. The
1st accused Zee Chao Foo and the 12th accused Chen Yue

Chinese detective of the French Police who attended
this identification parade was informed accordingly.

No evidence has been obtained that the remaining
seven male and two female arrested persons have been
concerned in any crime. However, they were all either
directly or indirectly previously connected with the
13th Division of the Peace and Reconstruction Army
which has now been removed from the Shanghai Area and
as these persons have no means of livelihood in
Shanghai they must be considered as potential armed

尚未获得证据证明其余七名男性和两名女性被捕人员参与任何犯罪。然而，他们所有人都曾直接或间接地与和平救国军第十三师有关联，该师现已撤离上海地区，且这些人在上海没有生计来源，因此必须将他们视为潜在的持械抢劫犯。

H.Q.C.B. 9-1-42

My name is Zee Chao Foo alias Gee Chao Foo, 27 years
of age, native of Wusih, and residing in a Lodging House.

When I was young boy, I studied in a private school
in the city of Wusih, and at the age of 22 years I was an
apprentice in the Dah Kong Drapery Shop, located in the same
city.

At the age of 24 years (i.e. in the year 1939) I
came to Shanghai from my native place, and through the
introduction of one Gee Zau Liang, a friend of mine, I joined
the Peace & Reconstruction Corps and was employed as a
secretary under one Vai Keng Zai, who was the Sergeant-Major
of the 3rd Regiment of the 18th Route Army. Up to September
1941 the aforementioned army was disbanded, therefore I
returned to the place of my nativity, where I then became
unemployed.

On the 27-12-41 I came to Shanghai again and lived
in the Tsung Kiang Lodging House, located on Rue de Weikwe,
French Concession. After living in this Lodging House for a
period of two days, I met one Kong Ziang Yoong (not arrested),
an acquaintance of mine, who previously worked in the same
Army with me.

On 30-12-41 when Kong Ziang Yoong and myself were
rambling about the street, we met one named Yah Woo Zaing,
who formerly opened a tea-shop in Pootung. Owing to the
bankruptcy of his tea-shop, he came to Shanghai and lived in
Room 76 of the Three Friends' Lodging House, located on Rue
Pailkao, French Concession. The latter accompanied both

徐家新（Zee Chao Foo），别名祁家新（Gee Chao Foo）
// C.D.C. 206
已翻译
xxxxxxx Y.C. Chang

H.Q.C.B. 1942年1月9日

本人名为徐家新，别名祁家新，现年27岁，籍贯无锡，现居住于一家客栈内。

幼年时，本人在无锡市的一所私塾读书，22岁时在位于同一城市的大康绸布店当学徒。

24岁时（即1939年），本人从家乡来到上海，经朋友祁兆良（Gee Zau Liang，音译）介绍，加入“和平建国军”，在第十八路军第三团军士长魏敬哉（Vai Keng Zai，音译）手下担任秘书。直至1941年9月，上述部队解散，因此本人返回家乡，随即失业。

1941年12月27日，本人再次来到上海，居住在法租界维格威路（Rue de Weikwe，今复兴中路）的宗江客栈（Tsung Kiang Lodging House）。在该客栈居住两天后，本人遇到熟人孔祥荣（Kong Ziang Yoong，音译，未被捕），他此前曾与本人在同一军队服役。

1941年12月30日，当孔祥荣与本人在街上闲逛时，遇到一名叫叶武章（Yah Woo Zaing，音译）的人，他以前在浦东开过一家茶馆。由于茶馆破产，他来到上海，居住在法租界白尔部路（Rue Pailkao，今金陵西路）三友客栈（Three Friends' Lodging House）的76号房间。后者陪同

page_data.en:
- 2-

Kong **〔此处转录不清〕** n. Y ong and myself to his room, in which three other
persons (name unknown) were found to be present .

At that time Yah Woo **〔此处转录不清〕** spoke to us that as we were
lack of money, we ought to commit a robbery in seizing some.
He told us that every thing was ready for carrying on the
attempted robbery except some pistols, whilst Kong Ziang Yoong
replied he could dispose of this problem.

In the afternoon of the same day, Yah Woo **〔此处转录不清〕** led
Kong Ziang Yoong and three other persons to a place, i.e.
Sung Hee Shing Macaroni Shop, House 487 Hennessy Road, the
vicinity of which they investigated for purpose of committing
their robbery some days later.

At 12 noon on the 1-1-42 as I was wandering about in
No. 13 Wharf, the Bund, I met one Loh Kau Tseng (2nd accused),
a friend of mine, and then brought him to Room 28 of the
Tsung Kiang Lodging House, located on Rue de Woikwe, F.C. .

At about 5 p.m. on the 3-1-42 Kong Ziang Yoong in
company with Chen Yue Tsih (4th accused) also came to the
Tsung Kiang Lodging House for purpose of discussing how to
carry on their attempted robbery, and they further made an
engagement to meet in Room 604 of the Wah Woo Lodging House,
located on Avenue Edward VII, F.C. at 7 p.m. the same day.

On the appointed time I accompanied Loh Kau Tseng to
Room 604 of the Wah Woo Lodging House, wherein we saw Kong
Ziang Yoong, Yah Woo Leung and 3 or 4 other persons were all
present at the time.

At about 8 p.m. same date, Yah Woo Leung and Kong Ziang
page_data.zh:
- 2-

孔**〔此处转录不清〕**n. Y ong 和本人前往他的房间，发现房内还有另外三人（姓名不详）。

当时，叶武**〔此处转录不清〕**对我们说，既然我们缺钱，就应该实施抢劫以获取钱财。他告诉我们，除了手枪外，实施抢劫的一切准备都已就绪，而孔祥荣回答说他能解决这个问题。

当天下午，叶武**〔此处转录不清〕**带领孔祥荣和另外三人前往一处地点，即轩尼诗路487号（Hennessy Road，今江西中路附近或指具体路段，注：原文Hennessy Road通常指湾仔，但在上海语境下可能指代错误或特定小街，结合后文河南路487号，此处可能为OCR错误或口供偏差，暂按原文译出）的宋兴盛面馆（Sung Hee Shing Macaroni Shop），他们勘察了该地周围的情况，以便几天后实施抢劫。

1942年1月1日中午12点，当本人在外滩13号码头附近徘徊时，遇到了我的朋友罗孝传（Loh Kau Tseng，第二被告），随后带他到法租界维格威路（Rue de Woikwe，疑为Weikwe之误）宗江客栈的28号房间。

1942年1月3日下午5点左右，孔祥荣伙同陈月吉（Chen Yue Tsih，第四被告）也来到宗江客栈，目的是商讨如何实施抢劫计划，并进一步约定于当天晚上7点在法租界爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII，今延安东路）华屋客栈（Wah Woo Lodging House）的604号房间会面。

在约定时间，本人陪同罗孝传前往华屋客栈604号房间，在那里我们看到孔祥荣、叶武良（Yah Woo Leung，音译）以及另外三四个人都在场。

同日晚上8点左右，叶武良和孔祥

page_data.en:
- 3 -

Yoong, each armed with a pistol, led all of us to leave the
Dah Woo Lodging House, and then travel along Avenue Edward VII,
F.C., Shantung Road, Nanking Road, Henan Road, and finally
we arrived at 487 Honan Road, i.e. the address of the Sung
Nee Shing Chinese Macaroni Shop. Then Lee Ching Kong (3rd
accused) kept a watch on the opposite side-walk of the street
and I in front of the shop, while all the other members of
our party entered inside the shop. After about 10 minutes,
some rushed out of the said premises, and then each one of
our party returned back separately to Room 604 of the Dah
Woo Lodging House. Those who returned back earlier were led
by Yah Woo Zaung and Kong Ziang Yoong to another Lodging
House (Sign-board and address unknown to me), because they
were afraid that their criminal case might be discovered by
others. I, reaching the room the latest, was not on time to
follow them and unable to find their whereabouts, hence I
stayed in the Tsung Kiang Lodging House for one more night.
At about 9 a.m. the next day, i.e. on 4-1-48, Kong
Ziang Yoong came to my room and told me that an amount of
$1,600.00 was robbed from the Sung Nee Shing Macaroni Shop
the other evening. In the meantime I received from Kong Ziang
Yoong a share of $50.00 of their loot for myself, and another
share of $50.00 for Loh Kai Tsang (2nd accused), and after
this, Kong Ziang Yoong left my room.
At 12 noon, same date, Loh Kai Tsang (2nd accused)
visited me in my room, whilst I gave the said sum of $50.00
to him at once.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

荣各持一把手枪，带领我们所有人离开大屋客栈（Dah Woo Lodging House，前文为Wah Woo，此处原文不一致，照实译出），然后沿着法租界爱德华七世路、山东路、南京路、河南路行进，最后到达河南路487号，即宋尼盛中式面馆（Sung Nee Shing Chinese Macaroni Shop）的地址。随后，李正康（Lee Ching Kong，第三被告）在街道对面的人行道上放哨，本人在店门前放哨，而我们团伙的其他成员则进入店内。大约10分钟后，一些人从上述场所冲出来，随后我们团伙的成员各自返回大屋客栈（Dah Woo Lodging House）的604号房间。较早返回的人由叶武章（Yah Woo Zaung，音译）和孔祥荣带领前往另一家客栈（招牌和地址本人不详），因为他们担心自己的刑事案件会被他人发现。本人最后到达房间，没来得及跟上他们，也无法找到他们的下落，因此在宗江客栈又住了一晚。第二天上午9点左右，即1948年1月4日（原文如此，应为1942年），孔祥荣来到我的房间，告诉我前一天晚上从宋尼盛面馆抢得了1,600.00元。同时，我从孔祥荣那里分得赃款50.00元，他还给了罗凯昌（Loh Kai Tsang，第二被告，前文为Loh Kau Tseng，人名拼写不一致，照实译出）一份50.00元，之后孔祥荣离开了我的房间。
同日中午12点，罗凯昌（第二被告）来我房间探望，我立即将上述50.00元交给了他。

page_data.en:
- 4 -

At 2 a.m. on the 6-1-42, Kong Aing Yoong came to me
and said that he had booked a room at Room 202 of the Tsung
Hwa Lodging House, located on Foochow Road. I then left my
room and together with Kong Aing Yoong went to the Tsung
Hwa Lodging House. As the latter room was too small for our
group of persons to live in, Kong Aing Yoong in company
with me went to book another room at Rm. 50 of the Shanghai
Sing Lodging House, located on Hupeh Road, wherein only I,
myself stayed that night, whilst he went to stay in a
brothel, located at the rear of the China Theatre.

At about 2 p.m. on the 7-1-42 when I went to Room 202
of the Tsung Hwa Lodging House to visit Kong Aing Yoong, who
was absent at the time, I was arrested by the police.

This is my true statement.

.......... ..........

The following described persons participated in this
robbery, are still not arrested:-

1. Kong Aing Yoong, age 28 years, height 5' 8", medium
build, long face, yellow hair, brushed back, wearing
grey coloured foreign dress, and sometimes wearing
Chinese long gown, Footung dialect.

2. Yah Hoo Zaung, age about 35 years, height about
5' 8", pale complexion, round face, medium build,
hair brushed backward, wearing grey coloured Long
gown, Footung dialect.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

1942年1月6日凌晨2点，孔英荣（Kong Aing Yoong，音译，前文为Kong Ziang Yoong，拼写不一致，照实译出）来找我，说他在福州路中华客栈（Tsung Hwa Lodging House）的202号房间订了一个房间。于是我离开自己的房间，与孔英荣一同前往中华客栈。由于该房间太小，容不下我们要住的一群人，孔英荣便和我一起去湖北路上海新客栈（Shanghai Sing Lodging House）的50号房间另订了一间房，当晚只有我一人住在那里，而他则去中国大戏院后面的一家妓院过夜。

1942年1月7日下午2点左右，当我去中华客栈202号房间拜访孔英荣时，他当时不在，我被警察逮捕。

这是我的真实陈述 ____ 

以下描述的人员参与了此次抢劫，尚未被捕：-

1. 孔英荣（Kong Aing Yoong），28岁，身高5英尺8英寸，中等身材，长脸，黄发，向后梳理，身穿灰色西式服装，有时穿中式长袍，讲浦东话。

2. 叶胡章（Yah Hoo Zaung，音译），约35岁，身高约5英尺8英寸，面色苍白，圆脸，中等身材，头发向后梳理，身穿灰色长袍，讲浦东话。

page_data.en:
- 5 -

3. Male person (name unknown), age about 30 years,
height about 5' 9", strong build, yellow complexion,
square face, big eyes, wearing grey coloured long
gown padded with cotton, Shanghai dialect.

4. Male person (name unknown), age about 40 years,
height 5' 6", strong build, yellow & round face,
hair cut short, wearing black long gown padded
with cotton, Shanghai dialect.

Signed:

3. 男性一人（姓名不详），约30岁，身高约5英尺9英寸，体格强壮，面色黄，方脸，大眼睛，身穿灰色棉长袍，讲上海话。

4. 男性一人（姓名不详），约40岁，身高5英尺6英寸，体格强壮，面色黄且圆脸，短发，身穿黑色棉长袍，讲上海话。

(陆孝传) 1 (邵得標)
Loh Kau Tsang alias Lau Duh 1ac
/// .b.c. li
translated
xxxxxx Y.C. Chang
-1-42

My name is Loh Kau Tsang alias Lau Duh 1ac, 28 years of age, native of Po Tung, M/Hawker, and residing at House No. 29 Loh Kah Sui, Po Tung, but N.F.A. in Shanghai.

During my boyhood I followed my parents to farm in the fields in my native place. In May 1941 through the introduction of a acquaintance of mine (Name unknown), I was employed as an orderly in the special service section of the 15th division. In July the same year I resigned from this work and became a hawker henceforth.

On the 1-1-42 when I was on board a ship to Shanghai from Pootung and got on shore from No. 13 wharf, the Bund, I met a friend of mine named Zee Chao Foo (1st accused), and then accompanied him to book Room No. 28 of the Tsung Kiang Lodging House, located on Rue de Walkwe, French Concession, wherein both of us lived together.

At about 6 p.m. on the 2-1-42 I together with Zee Chao Foo visited Room No. 76 of the Three Friends' Lodging House, Located at Rue Palikao, French Concession where the latter introduced me to get acquaintance with one named Kong Ziang Yoong. At that moment Kong Ziang Yoong spoke to me that a Sung Hee Chinese Macaroni Shop, located at 487 Honan Road, was in possession of a great deal of money and he attempted to carry on a robbery in this shop. He asked me to join their party also and promised that he would dispatch someone to call me in the Tsung Kiang Lodging House at 6 p.m. on 3-1-42, whilst I agreed with his opinion.

At about 6 p.m. the next day, i.e. on 3-1-42, Zee Chao Foo
page_data.zh:
nd a __d

(陆孝传) 1 (邵得標)
罗孝传（Loh Kau Tsang），别名刘笃（Lau Duh 1ac，原文乱码，音译）
/// .b.c. li
已翻译
xxxxxx Y.C. Chang
1942年1月

本人名为罗孝传，别名刘笃，现年28岁，籍贯浦东，职业小贩，居住在浦东罗家碎（Loh Kah Sui，音译）29号，但在上海无固定住址。

童年时期，本人随父母在家乡田间务农。1941年5月，经一位熟人（姓名不详）介绍，本人在第十五师特务连担任勤务兵。同年7月，本人辞去这份工作，此后成为小贩。

1942年1月1日，本人乘船从浦东前往上海，在外滩13号码头上岸时，遇到了我的朋友徐家福（Zee Chao Foo，第一被告，前文为Zee Chao Foo，此处拼写略有差异，照实译出），随后陪同他到法租界沃克威路（Rue de Walkwe，音译，疑为Weikwe之误）宗江客栈预订了28号房间，我们两人同住于此。

1942年1月2日下午6点左右，本人与徐家福一起访问了位于法租界白尔部路（Rue Palikao）三友客栈的76号房间，在那里他介绍我认识了名叫孔祥荣（Kong Ziang Yoong）的人。当时孔祥荣对我说，位于河南路487号的宋兴中式面馆（Sung Hee Chinese Macaroni Shop）拥有大量钱财，他企图对该店实施抢劫。他邀请我也加入他们的团伙，并承诺会在1942年1月3日下午6点派人到宗江客栈叫我，我同意了他的提议。

次日（即1942年1月3日）下午6点左右，徐家福

page_data.en:
- 2 -

in company with one Chen Yue Tsih (4th accused) visited me in
the Tsung Kiang Lodging House and then brought me to Room 604
of the Dah Foo Lodging House, located on Avenue Edward VII,
French Concession, wherein Kong Ziang Yoong and 4 or 5 other
persons (Name unknown) were present.

At about 8 p.m. the same day, I together with Lee Chao
Foo, Chen Yue Tsih, Kong Ziang Yoong and 4 or 5 persons
(name unknown) travelled to No. 497 Honan Road for purpose of
robbing Sung Nee Chinese Macaroni Shop, and on arrival at
the address in question, we saw that its door was closed, but
its small window still opened.

At that moment, on instructions of Kong Ziang Yoong,
I kept watch in front of the shop and Lee Chao Foo on the
opposite side-walk of the street, whilst Kong Ziang Yoong and
another person (name unknown) each took out a pistol from
their bodies, and then they together with Chen Yue Tsih
and 2 or 3 other persons (name unknown) entered the said
shop. After about 10 minutes as all of them, having done
their work, ran out of the mentioned premises, I then returned
back to the Tsung Kiang Lodging House by taking a ricksha.

At about 10 a.m. the next day, i.e. 4-1-42, both Kong
Ziang Yoong and Lee Chao Foo arrived at Room 28 of the Tsung
Kiang Lodging House, while Kong Ziang Yoong distributed me
a sum of $20.00 of their robbed money. The amount of money,
robbed from the shop mentioned above, is unknown to me.

On 5-1-42, Lee Chao Foo came to the Tsung Kiang Lodging
House and brought me to Room 308 of the Tsung Hwa Lodging

**〔此处转录不清〕**
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

伙同陈月吉（第四被告）来宗江客栈看望我，然后将我带到法租界爱德华七世路大福客栈（Dah Foo Lodging House，前文为Wah Woo，此处原文不一致，照实译出）的604号房间，孔祥荣和另外四五个人（姓名不详）正在那里。

同日晚上8点左右，本人与李朝福（Lee Chao Foo，音译，前文为Zee Chao Foo/Lee Ching Kong等，人名混乱，照实译出）、陈月吉、孔祥荣以及四五名其他人（姓名不详）前往河南路497号（前文为487号，此处原文不一致，照实译出），目的是抢劫宋尼中式面馆（Sung Nee Chinese Macaroni Shop）。到达上述地址时，我们看到店门紧闭，但小窗户还开着。

当时，按照孔祥荣的指示，本人在店门前放哨，李朝福在街道对面的人行道上放哨，而孔祥荣和另一人（姓名不详）各自从身上掏出手枪，然后他们与陈月吉及另外两三人（姓名不详）一起进入了上述店铺。大约10分钟后，当他们完成行动并从上述场所跑出来后，本人便乘人力车返回宗江客栈。

次日上午10点左右，即1942年1月4日，孔祥荣和李朝福都来到宗江客栈28号房间，孔祥荣分给我赃款20.00元。上述店铺被抢的金额本人不详。

1942年1月5日，李朝福来到宗江客栈，带我去中华客栈的308号房间

**〔此处转录不清〕**

page_data.en:
- 2 -
Located at House No. 638 **〔此处转录不清〕** and for subsequent, and
I soon returned back to the Toun **〔此处转录不清〕** House again.
At about 3 p.m. on the 7-1-48, I visited their
room again, but no sooner had I arrived at the Toun **〔此处转录不清〕**
Lodging House than I was arrested by the U. S. Police.
This is my true statement.

Signed:
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
位于638号房屋 **〔此处转录不清〕** 以及后续，
我很快又回到了唐 **〔此处转录不清〕** 客栈。
1948年1月7日（原文如此，应为1942年）下午3点左右，我再次去他们的房间，但我刚到唐 **〔此处转录不清〕** 客栈，就被美国警察逮捕。
这是我的真实陈述。

3rd accused

Lee Ching Kong ( 李 正 康 )
Nanking // C.M.S. 341
translated
C. B. H. Q. 9-1-42 -------- Y.C. Chang

My name is Lee Ching Kong alias Yih Sing Woo, 25
residing
years of age, native of Nanking, married, and/Ching Wei Jao
Market, Pootung.

I was born in Loong Doo Market, Nanking.

At the age of 5 years I commenced schooling in a
private school in the place of my nativity, and, owing to
the poor financial circumstances of my family, I ceased my
studies at the age of 6. I then helped my father to work
in the farm at my native place up to the age of 15.

When I was 16 years old I enlisted myself as a
soldier at Tsu Sai Wei outside the city of Nanking. Before
the outbreak of the August 13th incident, the army, which I
was attached to, was reorganised, hence I promoted to the rank
of 1st class soldier attached to the 8th row, 7th company,
3rd battalion, 15th regiment of the 88th Division, which was
then dispatched to Shanghai and stationed at Bah Loong Kong,
Pootung, but the army was disbanded afterwards.

In the year 1938 I became an orderly in the 3rd
company of the Special Service Battalion of the Peace & Recon-
struction Corps, which was stationed at Bah Jao Village,
Minghong. During my three years' services in the corps, I was
in good friendship with one Kong Ziang Yoong, who was a
captain of the 1st row of the 3rd company.

On the 1-1-42 (i.e. New Year's day) it was a holiday
that Kong Ziang Yoong and myself made an engagement to travel
to Shanghai. At 3 p.m. that day both of us started our journey
at Bah Jao Village, Minghong and at 5 p.m. same date we
page_data.zh:
第三被告

李正康 ( 李 正 康 )
南京 // C.M.S. 341
已翻译
C. B. H. Q. 1942年1月9日 -------- Y.C. Chang

本人名为李正康，别名叶胜武（Yih Sing Woo，音译），25
居住
岁，籍贯南京，已婚，和/静围灶（Ching Wei Jao，音译）
市场，浦东。

本人出生于南京龙都市场（Loong Doo Market，音译）。

5岁时，本人在家乡的私塾开始上学，由于
家庭经济状况不佳，本人在6岁时辍学。随后，本人
帮助父亲在家乡农场干活，直到15岁。

16岁时，本人在南京城外的祖赛卫（Tsu Sai Wei，音译）参军入伍。在八一三事变爆发前，本人
所属的部队进行了重组，因此本人晋升为一等兵，隶属于
第八十八师第十五团第三营第七连第八排，该部队
随后被派往上海，驻扎在浦东八龙港（Bah Loong Kong，音译），但该部队后来解散了。

1938年，本人成为“和平建国军”特务营第三连的勤务兵，该部队驻扎在明鸿巴灶村（Bah Jao Village, Minghong，音译）。在部队服役的三年期间，本人与孔祥荣（Kong Ziang Yoong）建立了良好的友谊，他是第三连第一排的排长。

1942年1月1日（即元旦）是假期，孔祥荣和本人约定前往上海旅行。当天下午3点，我们两人从明鸿巴灶村出发，同日下午5点我们

page_data.en:
- 2 -

arrived at Shanghai. We booked a Room at Roo 206 of the Dah
Tung Sing lodging house, located on Rue Palikao, French Concess-
ion where we rested for a while and then took our supper. Kong
Ziang Yoong used the whole night for visiting his friends,
while I slept lonely in the room.

At about 8 p.m. the next day, i.e. 3-1-42, Kong Ziang
Yoong brought into the room three persons, one of whom was
known to be named Yah Woo Zaung, the proprietor of a tea-shop
at Dah Kong, Pootung, but the names of the other two persons
were unknown to me. At that time all of us, consisting of
Kong Ziang Yoong, Yah Woo Zaung, myself and the other two
persons, gathered in the room and proposed that all of us
should carry out a robbery if we wished to relieve our poor
financial conditions, and this was agreed by all. After about
half an hour, while Kong Ziang Yoong and Yah Woo Zaung were
going to leave the room, the former gave me $10.00 for my
food and told me still live in the Dah Tung Sing lodging house
waiting for his good information. Both of them did not return
to the room that whole night.

At 7 p.m. 3-1-42 while I was staying in the Dah Tung Sing
lodging house, Kong Ziang Yoong and Yah Woo Zaung accompanied
by two unknown male persons called on me and told me to
participate in their conspiracy (robbery). At about 7.30 p.m.
all of us (five in number) left the lodging house and proceeded
to the corner of Henan & Tientsin Roads where on instructions
of Kong Ziang Yoong we were told to wait for a short time,
while he left the spot for some other place from where he later
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

抵达上海。我们在法租界白来尼蒙马浪路（Rue Palikao）的大同兴客栈206号房间订了一间房，在那里休息了一会儿，然后吃了晚饭。孔祥荣（Kong Ziang Yoong）整晚都去拜访他的朋友，而我独自一人在房间里睡觉。

第二天晚上8点左右，即1942年1月3日，孔祥荣带了三个人进入房间，其中一人已知名为叶友章（Yah Woo Zaung），是浦东大港一家茶馆的老板，但另外两人的姓名我并不知道。当时，包括孔祥荣、叶友章、我以及另外两人在内的所有人聚集在房间里，孔提议如果我们想缓解贫困的经济状况，就应该实施抢劫，大家都同意了。大约半小时后，孔祥荣和叶友章准备离开房间时，前者给了我10.00美元作为伙食费，并告诉我继续住在大同兴客栈，等待他的好消息。他们两人那整晚都没有回到房间。

1942年1月3日晚上7点，当我住在大同兴客栈时，孔祥荣和叶友章带着两名身份不明的男子来找我，让我参与他们的阴谋（抢劫）。晚上7点半左右，我们所有人（共五人）离开客栈，前往河南路与天津路的拐角处，按照孔祥荣的指示，我们在那里稍作等待，而他则离开该地点去了别处，随后他从那里

page_data.en:
- 3 -

brought to us another three persons, Zee Chao Foo (1st acc.)
Loh Kau Tsang (2nd accused) and Chen Yue Tsih (4th accused).
Under the leadership of Kong Ziang Yoong we then went to
Sung Nee Shing Macaroni Shop, 487 Homan Road. On arrival we
found that the shop in question had just closed for the day,
but its front door had not yet been locked. We all entered the
shop under the pretext of visiting friends, with the exception
of Zee Chao Foo, Loh Kau Tsang and two other unknown male
persons.
Having gained the entrance, Kong Ziang Yoong and Yah Woo
Zaung (both armed with a pistol) threatened the inmates to
keep quiet and at the same time instructed them to go upstairs
where they were detained in a rear room. In the ensuing time
I destroyed the iron safe by means of an iron axe, and with
the assistance of Chen Yue Tsih (4th accused) all banknotes
together with subsidiary notes were put in a rattan basket
which was then handed over to Kong Ziang Yoong. I did not
know the exact amount of money in the rattan basket. After a
lapse of ten minutes and on completion of our work, I descended
downstairs. On leaving the premises, I found that Zee Chao Foo
and two other unknown male persons took up their positions
as look-outs, while Loh Kau Tsang stood guard the front door.
I then returned to Room 206 of the Dah Tung Sing lodging house
for the purpose of waiting for their return but with no result.
At about 7 a.m. 4-1-48 Kong Ziang Yoong came to my room
and gave me $100 as my share of proceeds, also instructing me
to buy a suit of cotton long gown with which I could return
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

又带来了三个人：徐家富（Zee Chao Foo，第一被告）、陆考增（Loh Kau Tsang，第二被告）和陈月池（Chen Yue Tsih，第四被告）。在孔祥荣的带领下，我们随后前往霍山路487号的宋尼兴面馆（Sung Nee Shing Macaroni Shop）。到达时，我们发现该店当天刚刚打烊，但前门尚未上锁。除了徐家富、陆考增和另外两名身份不明的男子外，我们都以访友为借口进入了店内。

进入店内后，孔祥荣和叶友章（两人都持手枪）威胁店内人员保持安静，同时命令他们上楼，将他们拘禁在一间后屋内。在此期间，我用一把铁斧破坏了保险箱，并在陈月池（第四被告）的协助下，将所有钞票及辅币放入一个藤篮中，随后交给孔祥荣。我不知道藤篮里钱的确切数额。十分钟后，我们的工作完成，我下楼离开。离开现场时，我发现徐家富和另外两名身份不明的男子担任望风，而陆考增则把守前门。随后我返回大同兴客栈206室等待他们回来，但未有结果。1948年1月4日早上7点左右（注：原文年份疑似笔误，结合上下文应为1942年），孔祥荣来到我的房间，给了我100美元作为我的分赃所得，并指示我买一套棉长袍，以便我能返回

page_data.en:
- 4 -

to my corps. Before leaving my room, Kong told me that if
I wanted to seehim some time later, I could locate him in
Room No.202 of the Tsung Hwa lodging house, Foochow Road.
At about 5-6p.m. 7-1-42 I was arrested when I visited
Room No.202 of the Tsung Hwa lodging house, Foochow Road.
This is my true statement.

Signed :
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

我的部队。孔离开我的房间前告诉我，如果以后想见他，可以在福州路中华客栈（Tsung Hwa lodging house）202号房间找到他。
1942年1月7日下午5-6点左右，当我前往福州路中华客栈202号房间时被捕。
这是我的真实供词。

签名：

page_data.en:
Chen Yue Tsih ( 金 友 士 )
Pootung // C.U.C. 57
C. B. H. . 13-1-42 translated J.Y. Chien

My name is Chen Yue Tsih, age 24, M/Fruit hawker,
residing Pootung.
I was born in Sin Jue Village, Pootung.
At the age of 11 years I commenced schooling in the
Zeu Na Primary School, Sin Jue Village and ceased my studies
at the age of 14. I then became employed as an apprentice
in the Tsu Tseng Yuen Fruit Shop, Pootung until 18 when I
secured employment in the Yah Dah Fruit Shop, Tseupoo where
I worked for some time.
Resultant from the outbreak of the August 13th Incident
1937, the last mentioned fruit shop was compelled to suspend
operation due to dull business, there I enlisted myself as a
member of the Tseupoo Defence Corps which was organized for
the purpose of protecting people on that locality. On May 1938
I resigned from the corps due to low wages and returned to
my native place.
Later I secured employment in the Yue Tai Zing Fruit
Shop, Dah Dan Village, but I lost this job on May 1940 when
the shop closed down.
On 30-12-41 I received a letter from one of my
fellow countrymen named Kong Siang Yoeng (not arrested) in
Shanghai, telling me to meet him at Room No.27 of the Tsung
Kiang Lodging House, Rue de Weikwei, French Concession,
as early as possible.
At 1 p.m. 2-1-42 I left Pootung by boat and reached
Shanghai at about 2 p.m. Soon after I took up my abode in
Room 29 of the Hwa Tung lodging house, Shantung Road.
page_data.zh:
陈月池（金友士）
浦东 // C.U.C. 57
C. B. H. . 1942年1月13日 翻译 J.Y. Chien

我叫陈月池，24岁，男/水果小贩，居住于浦东。
我出生于浦东新居村（Sin Jue Village）。
11岁时，我在浦东新居村的泽纳小学（Zeu Na Primary School）开始上学，14岁时辍学。随后我在浦东祖曾元水果店（Tsu Tseng Yuen Fruit Shop）当学徒，直到18岁，之后在歇浦路（Tseupoo）的亚达水果店（Yah Dah Fruit Shop）找到工作，工作了一段时间。
由于1937年八一三事变的爆发，上述水果店因生意清淡被迫停业，我便加入了歇浦保卫团，该组织旨在保护当地民众。1938年5月，我因工资低微从保卫团辞职，返回家乡。
后来我在大丹村（Dah Dan Village）的月泰兴水果店（Yue Tai Zing Fruit Shop）找到工作，但该店于1940年5月倒闭，我也因此失业。
1941年12月30日，我收到一封来自在上海的同乡孔祥荣（Kong Siang Yoeng，未被捕）的信，叫我尽快去法租界维格威尔路（Rue de Weikwei）宗江客栈（Tsung Kiang Lodging House）27号房间与他见面。
1942年1月2日下午1点，我乘船离开浦东，约下午2点抵达上海。不久后，我入住山东路华东客栈（Hwa Tung lodging house）29号房间。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

At about 2 p.m. 3-1-42, I left the lodging house and
proceeded to Tsung Kiang loiging house where I met Kong.
Whilst we were talking together, two friends of Kong entered
the room, and through his introduction I learned that one
was called Zee Chao Foo (1st accused), and the other was
Loh Kau Tsang alias Zau Duh Pise (2nd accused). At that time
Kong proposed that all of us should carry out a robbery if
we wish to relieve our financial condition, and this was
agreed by all. Kong then suggested that all of us should
gather at 7 p.m. that day in Room 604 of the Dah Woo lodging
house, Avenue Edward VII. After that the 1st accused Zee
Chao Foo and the 2nd accused Loh Kau Tsang left the room.

At about 7 p.m. same date, I accompanied Kong Kiang
Yeong to Dah Woo lodging house. On arrival I found the
following persons were present ; Zee Chao Foo (1st accused),
Loh Kau Tsang (2nd accused), Lee Ching Kong alias Yih Sang
Woo (3rd accused), Ya Wee Zeung (not arrested), Ya Wee Zeung's
friend name not known and Tseu Ching San. Kong then said to
them that his intended task could be begun. Soon after all
the aforementioned persons left the lodging house and walked
north along Chekiang Road. On approaching Nanking Road, we
turned east till we reached Henan Road. On arriving at
Sung Hoo Shing Mercaroni Shop, 497 Henan Road at about
8.45 p.m., Kang Ziang Yeong armed with a pistol entered the
shop in question with Loh Kau Tsang (2nd accused), Lee Ching
Kong (3rd accused), Ya Wee Zeung and myself, while the 1st
accused Zee Chao Foo, Tseu Ching San and Yah Wee Zeung's frien
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

1942年1月3日下午2点左右，我离开客栈前往宗江客栈，在那里见到了孔。当我们交谈时，孔的两个朋友进入房间，通过他的介绍，我得知其中一人叫徐家富（Zee Chao Foo，第一被告），另一人叫陆考增（Loh Kau Tsang），别名赵杜皮斯（Zau Duh Pise，第二被告）。当时孔提议，如果我们想缓解经济状况，就应该实施抢劫，大家都同意了。孔随后建议我们所有人于当天晚上7点在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）大福客栈（Dah Woo lodging house）604室集合。之后，第一被告徐家富和第二被告陆考增离开了房间。

同日晚上7点左右，我陪同孔祥荣（Kong Kiang Yeong）前往大福客栈。到达时，我发现以下人员在场：徐家富（第一被告）、陆考增（第二被告）、李金京（Lee Ching Kong，别名易尚武 Yih Sang Woo，第三被告）、叶伟章（Ya Wee Zeung，未被捕）、叶伟章的一位姓名不详的朋友，以及周清山（Tseu Ching San）。孔随后对他们说，他计划的行动可以开始了。不久后，上述所有人离开客栈，沿浙江路向北行走。接近南京路时，我们向东转，直到到达河南路。晚上8点45分左右，到达河南路497号的宋虎兴面馆（Sung Hoo Shing Mercaroni Shop）时，孔祥荣手持手枪，与陆考增（第二被告）、李金京（第三被告）、叶伟章和我一起进入该店，而第一被告徐家富、周清山和叶伟章的朋友

page_data.en:
- 3 -

took up their positions as look-outs. Kong being the
leader ascended the 1st floor followed by us. In the
meantime I took from the accountant's desk several-ten
dollars, while Kong destroyed the safe and took out all
money from it, but I did not know the exact amount he had
taken.

After the fulfillment of our work, we descended the
stairs and made good our escape through various directions.
I returned to my room at Tsung Kiang lodging house.

At about 10 a.m. 4-1-42 Kong came to my place and gave
me $50 as my share of proceeds.

At 3 p.m. 5-1-42 Kong came again to me and informed me
that he had opened another room No.202 in the Tsung Hwa
lodging house, Foochow Road, at the same time accompanied me
to go there for recreation which I did, but I returned
to my place after a short time.

At 11 a.m. 7-1-42 Kong Ziang Yoong came again to me and
told me to attend Tsung Hwa lodging house at 4 p.m. sharp
that day. I went there accordingly at the stated time when
I was arrested.

This is my true statement.

Signed :
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

则担任望风。孔作为头目登上二楼，我们紧随其后。在此期间，我从会计桌上拿了几十块钱，而孔破坏了保险箱并取出了里面的所有钱，但我不知道他取走的确切金额。

完成行动后，我们下楼并从不同方向逃散。我回到了宗江客栈的房间。

1942年1月4日上午10点左右，孔来到我的住处，给了我50美元作为我的分赃所得。

1942年1月5日下午3点，孔再次来找我，告诉我他在福州路中华客栈开了另一个房间，号码为202，同时陪我去那里娱乐，我照做了，但不久后就回到了我的住处。

1942年1月7日上午11点，孔祥荣再次来找我，让我当天下午4点整去中华客栈。我按时前往，随即被捕。

这是我的真实供词。

and the following persons were arrested at the stated

1942年1月7日下午3点45分，日本宪兵队总部的伊藤少校（Major Ito）来到..B. ..，请求协助突袭蒲石路（Pootow Road）5号636弄中华客栈202室，以逮捕一个恐怖团伙的成员。

J.I. Pryde, J... Somewhere, 高级侦探督察李树发（Li Shu Fah），刑事侦探警士341号，刑事侦探警员252、211、205、87号提供了协助，并在上述地址逮捕了以下人员。

this room.

At 4.45 p.m. these detectives arrested the following
persons when they visited this room.

8th Nyl Kwai Chong (倪閏昌), 22, Pootung,
S/Major 13th Division, Pootung.

9th Lee Ching Kong (李金京), 25, Banking,
M/Soldier 13th Division Pootung.

10th Ching Tsu Chong (秦弄昌), 23, Kmpo,
S/Soldier, 13th Division Pootung.

11th Chen Chao Sang (陳覚初), 25, Pootung,
S/Doctor in Pootung.

12th Chen Yue Tsih (金友川), 24, Pootung,
M/Hawker, Pootung.

13th Chen Sung Sz (金沈氏), 16, Female,
wife of 12th accused.

The prisoners were questioned by members of the
Gendarmerie at C.B.H.. and eventually Sergeant Major
Ito stated that he was satisfied that these persons had
not been concerned in any anti-Japanese activity, but
according to his information they were a gang of armed
robbers and he therefore requested that these prisoners
be dealt with by the S.M.Police and charged before the
S.S.J.C. if sufficient evidence could be found against
them. The Officer i/c C.I. was informed and agreed.

At the request of the undersigned Sergeant Major Ito
left his informer in the custody of the S.M.Police for
24 hours to assist in enquiries.

1/2

此房间。

下午4点45分，这些侦探在有人访问该房间时逮捕了以下人员。

第8名 倪閏昌（Nyl Kwai Chong），22岁，浦东，
士兵/少校，第十三师，浦东。

第9名 李金京（Lee Ching Kong），25岁， Banking（银行业/银行界），
男/士兵，第十三师浦东。

第10名 秦弄昌（Ching Tsu Chong），23岁，Kmpo（原文不清，可能为地名或机构缩写），
士兵/第十三师浦东。

第11名 陳覚初（Chen Chao Sang），25岁，浦东，
士兵/浦东医生。

第12名 金友川（Chen Yue Tsih），24岁，浦东，

第13名 金沈氏（Chen Sung Sz），16岁，女性，

囚犯由宪兵队成员在中央捕房（C.B.H.）进行讯问，最终伊藤警曹长表示，他确信这些人未参与任何反日活动，但根据他的情报，他们是一个武装抢劫团伙，因此要求如果能找到足够的证据指控他们，则由上海公共租界工部局警务处处理，并在上海特区法院（S.S.J.C.）起诉。刑事调查处负责人获悉并同意。

应下述人员要求，伊藤警曹长将其线人交由上海公共租界工部局警务处拘留24小时，以协助调查。

At 6 a.m. on the 15-1-42 at the request of the

结果逮捕了井国雪（Tsing Kou Sie），27岁，山东人，男/无业，刑事处囚犯编号 31/42，但未查获任何具有定罪性质的物品。

1942年1月14日上午10时45分，日本宪兵队总部的井上（Inouye）警曹长来到刑事处总部（C.I.），请求立即协助逮捕一名中国男子，据称其在厦门路258号的一家中国旧铁店藏匿大量炮弹壳。

小林（Kobayashi）巡官、李树法（Li Shu Fah）副巡官、杉本（Sugimoto）副巡官、华籍侦探社警员62号和华籍侦探社警员290号提供了必要协助，并前往所述地址，将以下四名中国男子拘留：-

1. 范雲生（Vai Yung Sung），23岁， washerman（注：原文wash，可能指洗衣业或籍贯简写），男/店员，居住于厦门路258号。
2. 陸茂丰（Loh Mau Fong），22岁， washerman，男/会计，居住于厦门路258号。
3. 许桂秀（Han Kwei Sung），20岁， washerman，男/学徒，居住于厦门路258号。
4. 洪仲明（Hang Tseng Ching），41岁， washerman，男/店主，居住于 Wash（注：原文如此，可能指某地或行业）。

经搜查，在大量废铁中发现了约10件废弃炮弹壳，据称是由一名姓杨（Tang）的中国小贩带来的。

Sergeant Major Sano and two others were detailed to

On instructions of Officer i/c C.I, the four

At 3.30 p.m. same date, Sergeant Major Sano

根据塔布鲁姆（Tabrum）华籍侦探督察（C.D.I.）的指示，他们于同日午后5时被释放。

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 3.20 p.m. 15/1/42 Sergeant Major Furouji accompanied by five Chinese assistants came to C.B.H.Q. and requested assistance to visit 127 Shantung Road to seize a number of bombs.

（批：S/
86
16-1-42）

Assistance was rendered by Det. Pryde, D.S. Yamahara and D.S.I. Yang Shi Kwang and the stated address visited, which proved to be a paper shop. In a back room one stick bomb was seized which was concealed under shelves on which rolls of paper were stored.

The Gendarmerie party then immediately proceeded to 124 Shantung Road which is a printing shop immediately opposite the first address, and made a superficial search of this place, but no seizures or arrests were made here.

At the first address the following persons were arrested:-
1. Sung Kweh Liang (沈国樑), 32, Soochow, M/Accountant, 127 Shantung Road,
2. Sung Sui Ling (沈瑞麟), 41, Soochow, M/Accountant, 127 Shantung Road.

On return to C.B.H.Q. the Gendarmerie gave further clarification of this case by stating that the proprietor of 127 Shantung Road is one named Tsang Pei Ming who is the person who hid the bomb at this address and is connected with guerrillas in the Shanghai Area. 1942年1月15日下午3时20分，古路治（Furouji）警曹长 accompanied by five Chinese assistants（注：此处保留英文或译为“在五名中国助手的陪同下”）来到刑事处总部，请求协助前往山东路127号缴获一批炸弹。

（批：S/
86
1942年1月16日）

普赖德（Pryde）侦探、山原（Yamahara）副巡官和杨世光（Yang Shi Kwang）副巡官提供了协助，并前往所述地址，该处证实为一家纸店。在后屋的一只棍状炸弹被缴获，它被藏在存放卷纸的架子下面。

随后，宪兵队一行立即前往山东路124号，这是一家紧邻第一处地址对面的印刷店，并对该地进行了表面搜查，但在此未进行缴获或逮捕。

在第一处地址逮捕了以下人员：-
1. 沈国樑（Sung Kweh Liang），32岁，苏州人，男/会计，山东路127号，
2. 沈瑞麟（Sung Sui Ling），41岁，苏州人，男/会计，山东路127号。

返回刑事处总部后，宪兵队对此案作了进一步说明，称山东路127号的店主名为曾佩明（Tsang Pei Ming），即在此地址藏匿炸弹之人，并与上海地区的游击队有关联。目前似乎相信他在

（印：调查日期 1942年1月16日）

郭廷通（Ko Ling Tung），又名郭講（Ko Ting），32岁，闽海（Minhai，音译）人，杨树浦区 Wish 商人（原文不清，疑为某类商人），住法租界杜美路（Avenue Dubail）268弄18号。（刑事科档案号 32/42）

At __ a.m. on 9/1/42, Sergeant T. __ __ (崎次夫)
of the Japanese Gendarmerie, Gordon Road Sub-station,
came to the station and requested assistance in arrest-
ing a male Chinese, residing at No. __4 Ying Hwa Li,
Robison Road, who was suspected to have stored a large
quantity of kerosene and be in possession of an
unlicenced pistol, stating that an informant has seen
this man cleaning a pistol and 500 tins of kerosene
being stored in his home recently and that they suspected
him of being connected with assassination cases done by
Chungking Agents.

The assistance was rendered by D.S. to, P.C. 633
Yamasake, F.P.S. 853 Suzuki, C.I.S. 122, C.D.S. 255
and 317 and the man Ho Han Cheng (何漢丞), 53, Haichow,

Hwa Li, Robison Road was located at his dwelling house
No.s 3243-3244 Ying Hwa Li, Robison Road, and brought to
the station at 4.30 p.m. on 9/1/42.

A search of the premises failed to find any kerosene,
pistol or any document of political nature.

On instructions of D.O. "B" the man was loaned to the
Gendarmerie for one week (until 16/1/42) for ques-
tioning at 5.00 p.m. 9/1/42 after being fingerprinted.
Superintendent ____, C.I.D. informed.

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie H.Q.

At 12.45 p.m. 28-1-42 Sergeant Furuta of the
Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters (Foreign Section)
called at Crime Branch Headquarters and requested
assistance to visit the undermentioned addresses for
purpose of seizing Radio Transmitting Sets:-

1. Chengtu Road Police Quarters (Chinese)
2. China Union Radio Co.,
Lane 571, House 26, Burkill Road.

In reference to first mentioned address, D.C.
Crime and Special Branches was informed and gave
instructions that the raid was to be carried out,
however on arrival at that address it was ascertained
that the Transmitting Set was located in the Italian
Embassy and that they had merely hooked their antenna to
the roof of the Chinese Police Quarters at Chengtu Road
Station. No seizures were made.

The second address when visited was found to
have no transmitting set on the premises, but that the
occupants were merely engaged in the manufacturing of
Receiving Sets. No seizures were made.

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 6 a.m. 29-1-42 Sergeant Major Asano accompanied
by other members of Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters,
came to C.B.H.Q. and requested assistance to visit
House 7, Lane 286, Canton Road for purpose of arresting
a member of a Guerilla unit named Lee (李).

Necessary arrangements having been made with
Central Station, the desired assistance was rendered
by D.I. Crighton, DS. Sameshima and C.D.S. 62, however
on arrival at the address in question it was ascertained
that the wanted person had left home on the evening of
28-1-42 and had so far failed to return.

At the request of Sergeant Major Asano two
relatives of the wanted man named:-
1. Er Woo Sz (韓美氏), age 43, Wusih, M/Female,
2. Lee Soo Yung(李素文), age 19, Kiangying,
M/Female,
were taken to Crime Branch Headquarters for questioning
regarding the present whereabouts of the wanted man
whose particulars are as follows:-
Lee Shing(李銓) alias Lee Sai Sung(李善生)
age 40, Kiangying, M/Unemployed.

According to both the arrested females, who
claim they had only recently arrived from the country,
the wanted person has been in Shanghai since July 1941,

（左侧手写批注：S! / gl / 29.1.42）
（左侧手写批注：bad.）
（左下角印章：DATE 29/1/42）

协助日本宪兵队

1942年1月29日上午6时，日本宪兵队总部的浅野（Asano）警部补在其他成员的陪同下，来到刑事科总部，请求协助前往广东路286弄7号，以逮捕一名名为李（Lee）的游击队成员。

在与中央巡捕房做出必要安排后，由克莱顿（Crighton）督察、鮫岛（Sameshima）警司及华籍警员62号提供了所需协助，然而到达该地址后查明，被通缉者已于1942年1月28日晚离家，至今未归。

应浅野警部补的要求，将被通缉者的两名亲属，即：
1. 韓美氏（Er Woo Sz），43岁，无锡籍，女性，
2. 李素文（Lee Soo Yung），19岁，江苏江阴籍，女性，
带至刑事科总部，就以下被通缉者的当前下落进行讯问，其详细信息如下：
李銓（Lee Shing），别名李善生（Lee Sai Sung），40岁，江苏江阴籍，男性，无业。

据两名被捕女性称，她们声称最近刚从乡下抵达，

（左侧手写批注：S! / gl / 1942年1月29日）
（左侧手写批注：bad.）
（左下角印章：DATE 29/1/42）

1/2

and since that time has been unemployed, and that at
7 p.m. on the 28-1-42 he left home for an unknown
destination, but was expected to return home this a.m.
29-1-42.

In view of this latter disclosure Sergeant
Major Asano requested first that detectives be posted
at the home of this man pending his return and secondly
that both arrested females be handed over on loan for
further enquiries.

Both requests were acceded to, the females being
handed over against the usual receipt (attached).

John Coghlan
D. I.

两项请求均获准许，两名女性已凭常规收据（附后）移交。

宪兵队就环球无线电报有限公司存入各银行的款项对该男子进行了讯问。查获用于在银行单据上盖章的印章四枚。根据第一名被告提供的信息，宪兵队随后请求进一步协助，前往耶茨路（Yates Road）235弄23号，逮捕环球无线电报有限公司的出纳员。

2. 黄玉水（Wong Yuk Sui），38岁，上海人，环球无线电报有限公司女出纳员。

The following was seized at this address.

$230.00 in cash.

One paying-in book and one cheque book of the Yen
Yih(益) Bank.

One paying-in book and one cheque book of the Shanghai
Commercial and Savings Bank.

One paying-in book and one cheque book of the Nations
Commercial Bank.

Stubs of a used paying-in book of the Chase Bank.

2 chops.

Papers referring to outstanding accounts of Globe
Wireless Ltd. and payroll of staff etc.,

Questioned regarding the bank books seized the
accused state that after the Globe Wireless was sealed
by the Japanese authorities on Dec. 8th, Mr. R.C. Phillips
the acting manager of the Globe Wireless handed approxi-
mately $15,000.00 in notes to the 1st accused for
the December pay of the staff and the yearly bonuses .
This money was placed in the mentioned banks pending the
arrival of Chinese New Year when the bonus would be
paid to the staff.

On return to G.H.Q. Sub-Lieut. Katada stated
that he was going to question Mr. R.C. Phillips who lived
on 11th Floor Hamilton House. He was not accompanied by
any member of the unit. Whilst he was there found.

ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE

At 10 a.m. on the 9-2-42, Sgt. Major Nanbu of the Japanese Gendarmerie H.Q. attended at C.I. office and requested assistance in effecting the arrest of members of the Blue Shirts Society on Avenue Road in the vicinity of Lane 335 Avenue Road.

Kobayashi and C.D.C. 206 and on arrival at the above location, the wanted man was seen walking East along Avenue Road. Lee Tsung Hwa( 李振華 ), 20, Canton, S/Clerk in the employ of the S'hai & H'kow Wharf, residing Lane 335/16 Avenue Road. (C.I. Prisoner No. 35/42)

(C.I. Misc. No. 36/42)

13/360, Peking Road for the purpose of arresting one
male Chinese named Chih Tsai Moch (戚再玉), proprietor
of Tung Yoong Cotton Shop (長豐紗號) who was believed to

C.D.S.341, C.D.C. 206 and the above-mentioned address
visited but it was ascertained that the above said shop
had been closed during April 1941 owing to depression of
their business and also the wanted person was not
located in the premises. The party withdrew at 12 noon
9/2/42.

No arrest and no seizure.
Central Station informed.

1

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 2 p.m. February 15, 1942, Sergeant Major Kurouji
of the Gendarmerie Headquarters at'eniei C.B.F. . (C.I.)
and requested assistance to visit Room No.230 of the
Sinza Hotel, 341 Sinza Road and arrest a person therein
who, according to information received, was attempting
to buy arms and ammunition.

Assistance was rendered by D.S. Sameshima, C.J.S. 341
C.J.C. 57 and the undersigned.

On the room being visited at 2.10 p.m. one named
Tseu Yien Fung (赵一峰), 31, Shanghai,
married, Major in the Peace Preservation
Corps, 5th Division.
was questioned. He admitted having been sent to Shanghai
on January 4, 1942 by his Commanding Officer to buy arms
etc but stated he was arrested by the W.S.A.S.P.F. on
January 30th and later handed over to the Western Branch
of the Gendarmerie because he was in possession of mili-
tary arms. He was released on February 13th after his
story was verified.

The foregoing was also verified by telephone with
the Western Branch of the Gendarmerie and the parties
then withdrawn. No arrests or seizures were made.

D. S. I.

（印：INDEXED BY (S.B) REGISTER 18/2/42）

协助日本宪兵队

1942年2月15日下午2时，宪兵队总部的黑路治（Kurouji）警曹长来到刑事科总部（C.B.F. . (C.I.)），请求协助前往新闸路341号新闸酒店（Sinza Hotel）230室，逮捕其中一名据收到的情报称试图购买武器弹药的人员。

鮫岛（Sameshima）副巡官、C.J.S. 341、C.J.C. 57 及签署人提供了协助。

下午2时10分进入该房间后，对一名名为赵一峰（Tseu Yien Fung），31岁，上海人，已婚，和平建国军第五师少校的人进行了讯问。他承认其指挥官于1942年1月4日派他到上海购买武器等物，但称他于1月30日被汪伪上海市警察局（W.S.A.S.P.F.）逮捕，后因持有军用武器被移交给宪兵队西部支部。在其供述得到核实后，他于2月13日被释放。

上述情况也通过电话向宪兵队西部支部进行了核实，随后相关人员撤离。未进行逮捕或扣押。

副巡官兼侦探督察

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 1 a.m. on the 19th February 1942, Sub-Lieutenant
Katoda and six other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie
came to S.I. Offices and requested assistance to visit
two addresses at 684 Peking Road and 586 Ferry Road
for the purpose of arresting members of the Blue Shirts
Society who according to the information received by the
Gendarmerie officers could be located at these two
addresses.

Ah, C.D.S. 172, C.D.C. 83 and the undersigned accom-
panied by Sergeant Major Ikeda and three other members
of the Gendarmerie visited the address first mentioned
at 1.30 a.m. but no arrest or seizure were made.

The address at 586 Ferry Road was visited by D.I.
Kobayashi, D.S. Yoshinaga, D.S.I. Tang Shih Kwang, C.D.S.
341, C.D.C. 97 together with Sub-Lieutenant Katoda and
three other officers at 1.45 a.m. and the following
persons who are suspected of being responsible for
terrorist acts recently committed in the International
Settlement were arrested.

February 20th    42

3

Further to : Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 6.30 a.m. 20/2/42, Sergeant Major Yurouji and
three other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie Head-
quarters attended C.I. Office and requested assistance
in effecting the arrest of one named Woo Yot Shuen
(吴偉勳), age 41, who was alleged to be a member of
the Blue Shirts Society and could be located at the
Zung Kong Iron Shop, 623 North Soochow Road.

Assistance was rendered by D.S.P. Yang Shih Kwang,
C.D.C. 184 and 206 and the undersigned and on arrival
at the stated address it was ascertained that the wanted
person had left from the abovementioned shop about two
weeks ago and had gone to Wusih, his native place.

No arrest or seizure made.

The party then visited House 151 Lane 520 North
Soochow Road which is the guarantor's address of the
wanted person for the purpose of ascertaining Woo's
address in Wusih but this proved fruitless.

West Hongkew Station informed.

（印：INDEXED BY (G.A.) REGISTRY DATE 20/2/42）

续：协助日本宪兵队

1942年2月20日上午6时30分，日本宪兵队总部的Yurouji军曹长及另外三名成员来到刑事科办公室，请求协助逮捕一名名为吴伟勋（Woo Yot Shuen）的男子，该男子41岁，据称是蓝衣社成员，可能位于北苏州路623号众公铁铺。

由副督察杨世光、刑事侦探警员184号和206号以及本人提供了协助，到达上述地址后查明，被通缉人约于两周前离开上述店铺，已前往其家乡无锡。

未实施逮捕或扣押。

随后，该小组前往北苏州路520弄151号，即被通缉人的担保人地址，旨在查明吴在无锡的地址，但此举无果。

已通知西虹口巡捕房。

At 10.30 a.m. February 20, 1942, Sub-Lieutenant
Ikeda of the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters attended

Dah Tung (大同) University and Middle School, 1380
SinzA Road to effect the arrest of a student named
Lee Vung Kwei (李尤奎) who was alleged by persons
already in their custody to have been engaged in
Anti-Japanese activities.

Assistance was rendered by D.S. Yamahara, D.I.
Soong Ping Tsung, C.D.O.s 206 and 21 and the under-
signed when the address was visited but no trace of
the wanted man was found. As far as records show, the
wanted man has not registered for the new term which
begins to-day (20-2-42)

The party then withdrew, no seizures being
made.

1942年2月19日中午12时，Kurooji军曹长及日本宪兵队总部的其他三名成员，连同本档案日记1中提到的刑事科囚犯第79/42号Zau Tsong Hwa，来到刑事科办公室，请求协助走访下列地址，以逮捕三名被上述囚犯牵连为蓝衣社成员的中国男性。

1) 外滩7号中国银行，在此逮捕一名万老毅（Vai Ta 'yi），系上述银行职员。

2) 宁波路551号久昌金属店，在此逮捕一名孔振声（Kung Tsung Sung）。

3) 伯基尔路302号南洋职业补习学校，在此逮捕一名杨洪年（Yang Hoong Nylen），系上述学校教师。

作出必要安排后，由刑事侦探警员184号和206号、副督察Yoshinaga及本人组成的小组，在上述宪兵小组的陪同下，走访了第1和第2处提及的地点，囚犯Zau Tseng Hwa见到了受雇于那里的全体员工，但后者未能指出其中任何人为被通缉者。

该小组随即前往第3处提及的地点，但在那里进行的查询显示，

1.

ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE GENDARMERIE

At 1.15 p.m. 19-2-42, Sergeant Ikeda and four other members of the Japanese Gendarmerie H.Q. attended at C.l. Office together with their informer and requested assistance in visiting the Hu Ching Yue Dong (胡庆余堂) Medicine Shop, No. 664 Peking Road.

According to their story, on the night of 14-2-42 when the bomb explosion case occurred at the Nitto Shoji Kaisha, a Japanese owned hardware shop situated at No. 690/92 Peking Road, the informer caught sight of a suspiciously behaving Chinese in the vicinity of the above-said premises and the man in question entering the above-described medicine shop and this date, five male Chinese were seen carrying out a Chinese wooden suit-case from inside the alleyway which runs besides the shop in question, so the inmates of the shop may have some connection with the bomb explosion case.

Necessary arrangements having been made, a party comprising of C.D.C. 184 and the undersigned accompanied by the said gendarme party paid a visit at the shop and therein conducted thorough enquiries when one:-

Chiang Ah Kung (蒋阿公), 31, Wusih, M/messenger in the employ of the shop, residing at No. 10 Yue Ching Li, Naining Road (C.l. Prisoner No. 84/42) was pointed out by the informer as being one of the five

1.

协助日本宪兵队

1942年2月19日下午1时15分，Ikeda军曹及日本宪兵队总部的其他四名成员与其线人一同来到刑事科办公室，请求协助走访北京路664号胡庆余堂药店。

据他们陈述，1942年2月14日晚，位于北京路690/92号的日资五金店日东商会发生炸弹爆炸案时，线人在上述场所附近看到一名行为可疑的中国人，且该男子进入了上述药店；同日，有五名中国男性从该药店旁的小巷内搬出一个中式木箱，因此店内人员可能与炸弹爆炸案有关联。

作出必要安排后，由刑事侦探警员184号及本人组成的小组，在上述宪兵小组的陪同下走访了该店，并进行了彻底查问，其中一人：

蒋阿公（Chiang Ah Kung），31岁，无锡人，男/信差，受雇于该店，居住在南京路悦庆里10号（刑事科囚犯编号 84/42），被线人指认为五名

1

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 6.10 p.m. 19-2-42, Sgt. Tjorn Sato and Nanhu
of the Japanese Gendarmerie Force came to the C.I. Office
together with their prisoner named u Ah mu (胡阿毛),
age 41, native of Soochow and requested assistance in
raiding house 624/11 Tonguin Road wherein to arrest, if
possible, one named Lieu Yeu Ling (刘友林), age about 50
and one other who were implicated by the above-said
prisoner to be members of the New 4th Route Army who
had been deputed by the Army for the purpose of buying
up war materials at Shanghai.

Necessary arrangements having been made, a party
comprising of D.S.I. Yang Shih Kwang, C.D.Cs 84 & 184
and the undersigned accompanied by the Gendarme party
raided the house at 6.30 p.m. and, in an upstairs rear
room, effected the arrest of the undermentioned two persons and brought them to C.I. Office for interrogation.

1) Lieu You Ling (刘友林), age 51, Native of
Nanking, X/Hawker, residing o/o the above-
described address. (C.I. Prisoner No. 87/42)

2) Wong Shing Ding (王慶亭), age 37, native of
Anhui, residing at House No. 625 Tonguin Road.
(C.I. Prisoner No. 88/42)

Search of the room occupied by the said two persons resulted in the seizure of 8 small opium tins

协助日本宪兵队

1942年2月19日下午6时10分，日本宪兵队的Tjorn Sato军曹和Nanhu带着名为胡阿毛（u Ah mu）的囚犯来到刑事科办公室，该囚犯41岁，苏州人，请求协助突袭通运路624/11号房屋，以便尽可能逮捕名为刘友林（Lieu Yeu Ling）的男子（约50岁）及另一人，上述囚犯牵连此二人为新四军成员，系受军队委派在上海购买军用物资。

作出必要安排后，由副督察杨世光、刑事侦探警员84号和184号及本人组成的小组，在宪兵小组的陪同下，于下午6时30分突袭了该房屋，并在楼上后间逮捕了下列两人，并将他们带到刑事科办公室进行审讯。

1) 刘友林（Lieu You Ling），51岁，南京人，前/小贩，居住在上述地址。（刑事科囚犯编号 87/42）

2) 王庆亭（Wong Shing Ding），37岁，安徽人，居住在通运路625号。（刑事科囚犯编号 88/42）

对上述两人居住的房间进行搜索，查获了8个小鸦片盒

REGISTRY
No. D. 879/42
Date 24/2/42

Central    Misc.153/42    24/2/42

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie to visit
452, Klangse Rd.

At 8p.m 24/2/42 J.D.S Tsuji, J.D.S Yoshioka and the
undersigned rendered assistance to Sgt.Major Saito of
Western Japanese Gendarmerie, in visiting the roof of 452
Klangse Road from where it was believed a short wave
transmitting radio was being operated.

Examination of the roof resulted in an abandoned
radio transmitting studio being discovered in a small shed.
The studio had not apparently been in use for considerable
time. No arrests were effected but a few discarded papers
were retained by the Gendarmerie.

Report submitted for information.

-RM 25/2

中央    杂项 153/42    1942年2月24日

协助日本宪兵队前往
康塞路（Klangse Rd.）452号

1942年2月24日晚8时，日本侦探社（J.D.S.）辻（Tsuji）、日本侦探社（J.D.S.）吉冈（Yoshioka）及签署人协助西部日本宪兵队的斋藤（Saito）警曹长，前往康塞路452号的屋顶，据信那里有人操作短波无线电发射机。

对屋顶的检查结果是在一个小棚屋里发现了一个被废弃的无线电发射室。该发射室显然已有很长时间未使用。未实施逮捕，但宪兵队扣留了几张丢弃的纸张。

本报告呈报供参考。

-RM 2月25日

Re handing over a male Chinese to the Japanese Gendarmerie, Western
Detachment on Jessfield Road.
D.S. 775 In charge.
〔签名：ZIRADES Officer i/c.〕
〔签名：Yao Fan〕

Sir,

I beg to report that at 6.20 a.m. on 5/3/42, a
telephone message was received from P.C. 100 Kung Yuen
(吴根源) residing at Lane 730/5 Connaught Road
reporting that some persons, with arms, were loitering
in the above mentioned village.

On receipt of the message, D.S. 95, S.D.S. 128,
Serjts 314, 846 and 1551. Chu Lenz of proceeded to
the above said locality where the following facts were
revealed.

At about 6.15 a.m. oven date, Corporal Sedo,
attached to the Japanese Gendarmerie, Western Branch on
Jessfield Road, and his Party attempted to enter into
the house No.5 Lane 730 Connaught Road to arrest a male
Chinese from the premises.

Corporal Sedo stated that he wanted to apprehend
a male Chinese named Woo Kwung Sung (何昆森), 51,
Haimen, M/Merchant, residing above, for having concerned
in an extortion case.

The Party of Police assisted the Japanese authori-
ties and entered into the said premises where the wanted
person was placed under arrest.

Nothing, other than one certificate, was recovered
from the person of the arrested man.

Acting on instructions from D.O. "B" the arrested
man was loaned to the Japanese authorities for the period
of one week.

Corporal Sedo stated that he would send a receipt
for the male Chinese to this Station later.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,

关于将一名中国男子移交给驻极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）的西部支队日本宪兵队。
D.S. 775 负责。
〔签名：ZIRADES 负责人〕
〔签名：姚凡（Yao Fan）〕

先生，

谨此报告，1942年3月5日上午6时20分，接到居住在康纳特路（Connaught Road）730弄5号的巡捕100号吴根源（Kung Yuen (吴根源)）的电话留言，报告称有一些持械人员在上述村宅徘徊。

收到消息后，D.S. 95号、S.D.S. 128号、巡佐314号、846号和1551号以及朱伦茨（Chu Lenz）前往上述地点，查明以下事实。

约在当日早上6时15分，隶属于极司菲尔路西部支队的日本宪兵队世道（Sedo）下士及其一行试图进入康纳特路730弄5号房屋，以逮捕屋内的一名中国男子。

世道下士称，他想逮捕一名名为何昆森（Woo Kwung Sung (何昆森)）的中国男子，51岁，海门人，已婚/商人，居住于上述地址，因其涉及一起勒索案。

警方一行协助日本当局进入上述处所，并将被通缉者逮捕。

除了一张证书外，从被捕者身上未搜获其他物品。

根据“B”区值班警官的指示，将被捕者借给日本当局，为期一周。

世道下士表示，稍后将向本警局发送接收该名中国男子的收据。

此致，
敬礼，

Assistance rendered to the Japanese
Military Authorities.

Sir,

At 2.30 p.m. 11/3/42, Sergeant-Major K. Kubouchi
of the Bubbling Well Organ, Bubbling Well Road, M.I.,
accompanied by Det. Tanaka, attached to the Chengtu
Road Station, visited this station and requested
assistance to search the premises located at No. 4
Singapore Road, where a large quantity of copper is
stated to have been stored.

Obtaining a permission from 〔此处转录不清〕 by telephone
this office rendered assistance to the aforementioned
officers.

A search of the factory located at No. 4
Singapore Road revealed that cotton covered copper
wire weighing about 4064 lbs. and valued at $243,840.-
being stored on the premises, but they had already been
sealed by the Gendarmerie officers.

A visit was also paid by the aforementioned
officers to a factory at No. 565 Wuting Road where
unfinished cotton covered copper wire weighing about
9015 lbs. valued at $180,300.- and a large number of
electric motor parts (iron) weighing 134,000 lbs.
valued at $241,200.- were discovered. These were
also sealed by the Gendarmerie officers.

A Chinese named Chiang Chen Shun (蒋永) a
superintendent of the above mentioned two factories
(both operated by one concern) stated that all the
property sealed, had already been registered with the
Japanese Authorities by the head office.

In view of the above, the Gendarmerie officer

通过电话联系获得 〔此处转录不清〕 的许可后，本办公室向上述官员提供了协助。

对新加坡路4号工厂的搜查显示，现场储存有重约4064磅、价值243,840美元的包棉铜线，但这些物品已被宪兵队官员查封。

Re assistance rendered by Gordon Road Station

Sir,

I beg to report that at 5.30 a.m. on 18/3/42, a
telephone message was received from Japanese Army
Detachment, 1st Division, located on Sinza Road and Hart
Road corner, requesting a Police assistance to search
houses in this district.

Inspector Segawa, D.I. Hamachita, S.I. Yokosawa,
C.D.S. 319, C.D.S. 359, D.P.S. 860 Ueda and the party
of Uniform Branch, accompanied by the Japanese Authorities,
divided into four parties, proceeded to the following
mentioned localities, where a search was made amongst
the persons living in the vicinity resulting in three
male Chinese being taken into custody.

(1) On Hart Road between Singapore Road and Penang
Road.
About 100 houses were subjected to a search,
but without result.

(2) In Tong Mer Li, on Penang Road.
About 200 houses located in the said alley-
way, were searched, but also failed to locate
any suspect or weapon.

(3) In San Joh Li, on Tonquin Road.
About 300 Chinese dwellings were searched
resulting in two male Chinese suspects under
mentioned, being placed under custody from the
said alleyway at 10 a.m. even date.

(1) Zan Hych Ding (趙鶴亭), 48, Kiangsu,
M/Unemployed, No. 103 San Joh Li, Tonquin
Road.

At 11. 0 a.m. on /42 Sgt. Uayama of the Western
Branch Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters No. 94 Jess-

assistants came to this station and requested assistance
to visit Lane No. 123 House No. 13 Chentu Road to
conduct a search of the said premises, as information
had been received by him that a quantity of unregistered
gasoline was stored there.

The necessary assistance was given by D.P.J. Tanaka,
and in the compound of the above house were found hidden
under a stack of fire wood four 50 gallon drums of
gasoline, and also a further two 50 gallon drums and
ten 5 gallon tins were found concealed under a staircase
at the rear of the premises. Total amount of gasoline
found 350 gallons.

The above premises are occupied by the Hua Yih
Shing (華一新) Printing Company which is owned by one
named Ts Chia Ts (朱階之) above address, who was then
absent.

Enquiries at the scene revealed that the said
gasoline was not registered with the S.M.C.

Accordingly Sgt. Uayama sealed all the drums and
tins of gasoline, and gave instructions for same not to
be removed, until further instructions were received
from the Japanese Gendarmerie.

1942年 /42 上午11时，西部支队日本宪兵队总部（极司菲尔路94号）的上山（Uayama）警佐。O.O.L. 连同两名中国男性助手来到本警局，请求协助前往成都路123弄13号，对该处所进行搜查，因为他收到情报称那里储存有大量未登记的汽油。

D.P.J. 田中提供了必要的协助，在上述房屋的院子里，发现一堆木柴下藏着四个50加仑的汽油桶，另外在后楼梯下还藏有两个50加仑的桶和十个5加仑的铁罐。发现的汽油总量为350加仑。

上述处所由华一新（Hua Yih Shing (華一新)）印刷公司占用，该公司由上述地址的朱阶之（Ts Chia Ts (朱階之)）所有，当时他不在场。

现场查询显示，上述汽油未向工部局（S.M.C.）登记。

因此，上山警佐查封了所有汽油桶和铁罐，并指示在收到日本宪兵队的进一步指示之前，不得移动。

1942年3月25日上午9时55分，负责罗宾逊路（Robinson Road）路障搜查组的61号下士罗宾逊（Robinson）将一名中国男子王永太（Wang Yung Tai），26岁，南京人，住罗宾逊路633/113号，带至警局，因其试图在无许可证的情况下携带15张皮革通过路障。

经查，被捕人于1942年3月25日上午8时持有一份由日本宪兵队签发的准许运出的许可证，携带15张皮革通过路障进入租界；同日上午9时30分，他持同一份许可证试图再带入另外15张皮革时被搜查组逮捕。

已通知日本宪兵队，应其要求并根据“B”区巡官中村（Nakamura）先生的指示，该男子连同15张皮革于1942年3月25日上午11时10分移交给日本宪兵队。

Y'POO DETACHMENT
----------------------------------------

Regarding the arrested men in this case who were
loan to the Japanese Gendarmerie Y'poo Detachment for
a period of one week on 10-4-42, being not yet returned
to S.M.Police, the undersigned, on A.M. of 11-4-42,
visited the above Authority, interviewed with Captain
Taruno from whom it was ascertained that the arrested
8 persons had already been released by their Authority
on the divers dates as follows:-

1) Zee Zoong Dao (錢祿道),
2) Yang Ying Fong (楊英芳),
3) Sun Yih Kong (沈益拱),
4) Zee Lih Foong (錢立峰),
The above 4 persons released on 2-4-42.

5) Tsang S Bing (張樹屏),
6) Wong Boo Tseu (黃保祖),
7) Zung Si Bing (鍾世平),
8) Boh Yung Ong (卜榮君),
The above 4 persons released on 31-3-42.

Captain Taruno further stated that from enquiries
it was revealed that they were suspected to be concerned
in their past with Chinese Guerrillas, but as there
was no fresh evidence to prove their suspicion at
present, they, therefore, were released accordingly.

At 3 p.m. 28-4-42 Zao Zang Kyung, (趙長根), the person wanted for questioning as mentioned in previous diary, came to station together with Hsia Wong Sze (夏黃氏), wife of the man now in custody, namely, Hsia Shiu Chong. Zao Zang Kyung having been informed by Hsia Wong Sze regarding the incident came and stated the following facts to Police :-

On or before 19-3-42 one named Hsu Pah Ning (許伯寧) shipping hong broker, home address unknown, came to visit Zao Zang Kyung in his office formerly located at 12 Foochow Road and asked him to transport some cotton cloth to Sungkiang (松江) via Minghong (  ). Zao Zang Kyung agreed and received delivery from Hsu Pah Ning on 20-3-42 480 rolls of cotton cloth for transporting to Sungkiang. Zao also received at the same time $25,000.00 from Hsu as transportation fee. Having obtained the cargo, Zao Zang Kyung then handed same to Hsia Shiu Chong for transporting to the destination and gave latter $4,750.00 as transportation fee. The cargo was placed in Hsia's home (Lane 217/5 Yates Road) pending the issuance of the necessary transportation permit. However, Hsia Shiu Chong failed to obtain this permit, therefore, this cargo was intended to be returned to the owner. At this time free movement of cloth in large quantity was prohibited in the Settlement thus the cargo was temporarily deposited in Hsia's home pending the application for a return permit.

先生，

1942年4月28日下午3时，前次日志中提及的被询问人赵长根（Zao Zang Kyung），与目前被拘留者夏修忠（Hsia Shiu Chong）之妻夏黄氏（Hsia Wong Sze）一同来到警局。赵长根经夏黄氏告知此事后前来，并向警方陈述了以下事实：

1942年3月19日或之前，一名名为许伯宁（Hsu Pah Ning）的运输行经纪人（家庭住址不详）来到赵长根原位于福州路12号的办公室拜访，请求他经由明鸿（Minghong，原文空缺）将一些棉布运往松江（Sungkiang）。赵长根表示同意，并于1942年3月20日从许伯宁处接收了480卷棉布以运往松江。赵长根同时从许处收取了25,000.00美元作为运费。拿到货物后，赵长根将其交给夏修忠运往目的地，并支付给后者4,750.00美元作为运费。货物被放置在夏的住所（耶茨路 Yates Road 217弄5号），等待签发必要的运输许可证。然而，夏修忠未能获得此许可证，因此，这批货物打算退还给货主。此时租界内禁止大量布料自由流动，因此货物暂时存放在夏的住所，等待申请退回许可证。

Zao next visited Hsia at his office on the morning of
the 27/3/42, where Hsia informed him that he was unable to

informed Hsia that he had no godown at present in which to

The above property was stored in the above premises until
the 23/4/42 when Zao called at the house and removed to an
unknown destination by handtrolley 50 rolls of the cotton cloth.

Hsia states that he has not seen Zao since the latter date

Every endeavour was made by investigating officers to
locate Zao. His office situated at No. 53 Room No. 12 Foochow

Later Sgt. Major Ito, Officer i/c Japanese Gendarmerie

若能取得必要许可证，他承诺运输上述物资。

1942年3月23日上午，赵（Zao）来到夏（Hsia）的办公室，交给他7,000.00美元；同日下午2点左右，夏前往赵的办公室，又收到1,750.00美元，共计收到4,750.00美元作为运输费。

1942年3月27日上午，赵再次到夏的办公室拜访，夏告知他无法取得运输上述物资的许可证。赵随即告诉夏，他目前没有仓库可以储存这些物资，请求夏允许他将物资暂时存放在其位于耶茨路（Yates Road）217弄5号的家中。夏当即同意。1942年4月28日下午4点，赵将500卷棉布和7箱染料运至夏的家中。

上述财物存放在上述地点，直至1942年4月23日，赵来到该住所，用手推车运走了50卷棉布，去向不明。

夏称，自上述日期后他未再见过赵；此外，由于该财产不属于他，他不清楚这些物品是否已登记。

My name is Hsieh Chiu Thong, age 27, native of Ningpo,
w/manager of the Yun Ping Co., residing at Lane 217/5
Yates Road.

Sometime in January of this year, through business
connection, I became acquainted with Zao Ian; Yung who
is a manager of the Chung Hien Shipping Hong at Room 12,
2nd floor of 30 Foochow Road.

On March 20th, at about 10 a.m., he came to my office
and asked me to obtain a permit for him, because he had
some cotton cloth etc to be transported to Lingshong.

At 10 a.m. 23/3/42, he again came to my office and
paid me $3000.00 cash as transportation fee.

At 2 p.m., same date, he paid me a further amount of
$1750.00 as transportation fee when I called on him at
his office.

At 10 a.m. 27/3/42, Zao came to my office and asked
me about the permit. I told him that unless a permit was
issued by the China Affairs Board, nothing could be done
in the matter. Consequently, at 4 p.m. 28/3/42, Zao
transported by m/truck 500 rolls of cotton cloth and 2
cases of dye to my home at Lane 217/5 Yates Road, which he
asked me to keep for him temporarily at my home. When he
departed he said to me that he would come to take away
the goods and transportation fee from me after a few days.

At 12 noon 23/4/42, Zao came to my home and took away
a part of the stored goods ( 80 rolls of cotton cloth).
Since then, I did not see him.

我叫谢久通（Hsieh Chiu Thong），27岁，宁波人，云平公司副经理，居住在耶茨路（Yates Road）217弄5号。

今年一月某时，通过业务关系，我结识了赵延永（Zao Ian; Yung），他是福州路30号二楼12室忠贤航运行（Chung Hien Shipping Hong）的经理。

3月20日上午10点左右，他来到我的办公室，请我帮他办理许可证，因为他有一些棉布等货物要运往灵寿（Lingshong）。

1942年3月23日上午10点，他再次来到我的办公室，支付给我3,000.00美元现金作为运输费。

同日下午2点，当我去他的办公室拜访时，他又支付给我1,750.00美元作为运输费。

1942年3月27日上午10点，赵来到我的办公室询问许可证事宜。我告诉他，除非中国事务局（China Affairs Board）签发许可证，否则此事无法办理。因此，1942年3月28日下午4点，赵用卡车将500卷棉布和2箱染料运到我位于耶茨路217弄5号的家中，请我暂时代为保管。他离开时对我说，几天后他会来取走货物并结清运输费。

1942年4月23日中午12点，赵来到我家，取走了一部分存放的货物（80卷棉布）。此后，我便未再见到他。

主题：协助日本宪兵队在西区行动。

1942年5月8日凌晨12点05分，日本宪兵队总部西区准尉真锅（Matoba）先生来到本办公室，请求警方协助搜查虞洽卿路120号大华饭店（Grand Hotel）608室。他称，该房间内有多名中国男子，他们冒用日本当局的名义招募人员加入其党派，目的是前往镇海（Ching-hai）组织一支“水上警察”。

斋藤副巡捕（D.S.I. Saito）提供了协助，以下中国男子被带至本办公室：

(1) 马庭蒲（Mah Ding Poo），前镇海公安局督察主任，29岁，上海人，居住在虞洽卿路120号大华饭店608室。

Assistance to Japanese Gendarmerie

At 4.10 p.m. 29/5/42 J.S. 633 Yamasaki and C.D.S.47
brought to station a female Chinese named
Lieu Lai Di (劉麗弟), 26, Shanghai,
widow, 15 Market Lane, Robison Road,
（批：S.I. (as Yakeyama)）
who was handed over to them by one named Tsang Lien Kung
(張連光), Chief of 16th Pao, 3rd Section, who reported
that she was wanted by the Kiangwan Japanese Gendarmerie
Headquarters.
（印：17 5 30 本）

Enquiries by D.I. Ando, D.S. Ito, D.I. Zang Woo and
C.D.S. 47 revealed that on the 28/5/42 Japanese officials
from the Kiangwan Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters
visited 15 Market Lane, Robison Road, in an endeavour to
locate the above female, but she was absent. Tsang Lien
Kung was then warned by the officials to detain her should
she return home and report them by ringing up 08-2231.
（印：FILE）

At 4 p.m. 25/5/42 Tsang Lien Kung located her in
her home, detained her and later handed her over to
J.S. Yamasaki and C.D.S. 47 who were operating a search
party in the vicinity.

As far as can be ascertained from the Pao Chief,
the female and her sweetheart Tseu Hien Sung (周賢松),
age 34, native of Dah-sung (大宋), living at Dah-sung,
were wanted in connection with a case of murder of a
Japanese soldier in Kiangwan.
（印：INDEXED. BY (S.P.) REGISTRY 30 / 5 / 42）

协助日本宪兵队

1942年5月29日下午4点10分，日本警员633号山崎（Yamasaki）和中国侦探副巡佐47号将一名名叫刘丽弟（Lieu Lai Di）的中国女子带至分局，该女子26岁，上海人，寡妇，住罗宾森路（Robison Road）市场弄15号，
（批注：S.I. (as Yakeyama)）
她是由第三区第十六保保长张连光（Tsang Lien Kung）移交给他们的，张连光报告称江湾日本宪兵队总部正在通缉她。
（印：17 5 30 本）

经安藤督察（D.I. Ando）、伊藤巡佐（D.S. Ito）、张伍督察（D.I. Zang Woo）和中国侦探副巡佐47号查询，获悉1942年5月28日，江湾日本宪兵队总部的日本官员曾前往罗宾森路市场弄15号，试图寻找上述女子，但她不在家。当时官员警告张连光，如果她回家，务必将其扣留，并拨打08-2231向他们报告。
（印：归档）

1942年5月25日下午4点，张连光在她家中找到她，将其扣留，随后移交给正在附近执行搜查任务的山崎日本警员和中国侦探副巡佐47号。

据保长所述，该女子及其情人周贤松（Tseu Hien Sung），34岁，大宋（Dah-sung）人，住在大宋，因涉及江湾一名日本士兵被杀案而被通缉。

REPORT

Chinese Affairs, Sp.Br. Station. File No.____ Date June 13, 1942.

SUBJECT: Japanese Gendarmerie conducts raid on Hospital St. Marie.

According to reliable information, some 160 Japanese gendarmes together with the French Police raided the St. Marie Hospital at about 1.30 p.m. yesterday. The object of this raid, was to effect the arrest of a Chinese male, alleged to be the leader of the Special Service Squad of the Chungking Regime, who was said to be recuperating in the hospital. According to the Japanese gendarmes, the wanted man was accompanied by four armed bodyguards and it was for the reason that the gendarmes came in such large numbers.

No arrest is said to have been made while nothing was seized.

According to information received, the French Police objected to this raid because at the time of asking for assistance, representatives of the Japanese Gendarmerie did not indicate that such a large number of gendarmes would participate.

华人事务，特别分部警局。档案号____ 日期 1942年6月13日。

主题：日本宪兵队突袭圣玛丽医院。

据可靠消息，约160名日本宪兵会同法国警察于昨日下午1时30分左右突袭了圣玛丽医院（Hospital St. Marie）。此次突袭的目的是逮捕一名中国男性，据称其为重庆政权特别服务队的队长，据说正在该医院休养。据日本宪兵称，被通缉者由四名武装保镖陪同，这也是宪兵出动如此大规模人数的原因。

据悉未实施逮捕，也未缴获任何物品。

据收到的消息，法国警察对此次突袭表示反对，因为在请求协助时，日本宪兵队代表并未表明会有如此大量的宪兵参与。

静安寺                     杂项 248/42.      1942年8月29日。

协助日本宪兵队。

1942年8月29日凌晨1时30分，日本宪兵队罗伯特神父路分遣队的井上军曹来到本警署，请求协助前往哈同路142号实业小学，逮捕涉嫌从事政治活动的人员。第197号华籍巡官提供了必要协助，并前往该学校，以下人员被捕：-
(1) 梁志申，34岁，广东人，男/小学校长，居住于哈同路142号。
(2) 季九錦，33岁，Fompe（音译）人，男/教师，居住于哈同路142号。

1942年8月29日凌晨3时15分，同一名日本宪兵队军官再次来到本警署，请求协助在同一所学校逮捕其他人。第197号华籍巡官提供了协助，以下人员被拘留：-
(3) 汪競秋，34岁，青浦人，女，居住于哈同路142号。
(4) 汪競蘭，38岁，青浦人，女，教师，居住于哈同路142号。
(5) 汪競先，33岁，青浦人，女，教师，居住于哈同路142号。

所有被捕人员均被日本宪兵带走审讯。未扣押任何财物。

W. L. Wilson
副督察

高级警长负责人
